items.title: 最高法院判決後 美國已退還1,000億美元關稅 退款進度60%
items.title_en: After Supreme Court Ruling, U.S. Has Refunded $100 Billion in Tariffs, Refund Progress at 60%
paras: 美國最高法院一紙判定，讓美國政府不得不向進口商退還數千億美元關稅。
美國海關官員在向美國國際貿易法院提交的文件中表示，自最高法院今年早些時候認定川普政府無權動用緊急經濟權力徵收關稅以來，政府已退還約 1,000 億美元。
這筆退款相當於 4 月「對等關稅」以來所徵收的 1,650 億美元總額的 60% 左右。
美國政府退款推進之快，令業界人士頗感意外。Sidley Austin 貿易律師 Ted Murphy 說：「政府正在積極推進退款。」
咨詢公司 Capstone 分析師 Walker Livingston 也表示：「政府推進速度之快，讓我個人感到非常驚喜。」
美國海關周二（4 日）在法庭文件中說，已有逾 1,280 億美元被接受處理，意味著更多退款即將到位。
不過，退款並非人人有份。
美國海關的退款系統規定，只有直接向海關申報進口的主體才能提交申請。這意味著大量並未直接進口商品、但實際上通過更高採購成本或逐項附加費承擔了關稅的小企業，被排除在外。
一些小企業表示，根本不知道如何申請退款，或沒有能力完成申請流程。
結果是退款大多流向大型企業。德州進步派民主黨眾議員 Greg Casar 批評道：「川普把退款發給了企業，而不是普通勞動者。這些退款的每一分錢都應該還給美國消費者。」
儘管美國政府被迫退還數千億美元，川普政府並未放棄重建關稅壁壘。
今年 7 月，美國貿易代表辦公室發布公告，宣布依據《1974 年貿易法》第 301 條，以「強迫勞動」為由對數十個國家和地區加徵 10% 至 12.5% 關稅，以替代即將到期的全球進口關稅。
paras_en: The U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling that forced the U.S. government to refund billions of dollars in tariffs to importers.

U.S. Customs officials said in filings to the United States International Trade Commission that since the Supreme Court earlier this year determined the Trump administration lacked authority to invoke emergency economic powers to levy tariffs, the government has refunded roughly $100 billion.
That refund represents about 60% of the $165 billion in total tariffs collected since the “reciprocal tariffs” were imposed in April.
The speed of the government’s refund effort surprised industry observers. Sidley Austin trade lawyer Ted Murphy said, “The government is actively pushing the refunds forward.”
Capstone analyst Walker Livingston added, “I’m personally very surprised by how quickly the government is moving on this.”
U.S. Customs said in a court filing on Tuesday (the 4th) that more than $128 billion has already been accepted for processing, meaning additional refunds are imminent.
However, not everyone is eligible for a refund.

Customs’ refund system requires that only the entity that directly declared the import to Customs can submit a claim. This excludes many small businesses that did not import goods directly but effectively bore the tariff cost through higher procurement prices or item‑by‑item surcharges.
Some small firms said they have no idea how to apply for a refund or lack the capacity to complete the application process.

As a result, most refunds have flowed to large corporations. Texas progressive Democrat Representative Greg Casar criticized, “Trump gave the refunds to corporations, not ordinary workers. Every penny of those refunds should go back to American consumers.”
Even though the U.S. government is forced to return billions of dollars, the Trump administration has not abandoned efforts to rebuild tariff barriers.

In July, the Office of the United States Trade Representative announced, under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, new 10%‑12.5% tariffs on dozens of countries and regions on the grounds of “forced labor,” to replace the global import tariffs that are set to expire.

items.title: 黑石擬籌360億美元助Anthropic租晶片 AI融資閉環再擴大
items.title_en: Blackstone Plans $36 B Debt Deal to Help Anthropic Rent AI Chips, Expanding AI Financing Loop
paras: Anthropic 正持續擴大 AI 基礎設施布局。根據《彭博》引述知情人士報導，黑石集團 (BX-US) 已開始與潛在投資人接觸，計劃牽頭安排至少 360 億美元債務融資，專門協助 Anthropic 支付向 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 租用 AI 晶片與相關運算資源的費用。若交易順利完成，將超越今年稍早規模約 350 億美元的 AI 融資案，再度刷新私人信貸市場紀錄。
消息人士指出，這筆新融資將延續約兩個月前由阿波羅全球管理 (APO-US) 與黑石共同安排的 350 億美元私人信貸交易。該交易被市場視為史上規模最大的私人信貸案之一，主要用於支應 Anthropic 在五座資料中心租用 Google 客製化 AI 晶片 (TPU) 所需資金。
報導指出，Google 不僅是 Anthropic 的重要策略投資人，也是其主要算力供應商。Google 近年已向 Anthropic 投入數十億美元資金，而 Anthropic 再利用這些資金向 Google 租用 AI 晶片與雲端基礎設施，使 Google 的投資部分回流為租賃收入，形成市場高度關注的「資金閉環」(capital loop)。
此次 360 億美元融資也被視為上述模式的進一步延伸。知名分析師兼金融 Podcast 主持人 Ed Elson 形容，Google 向 Anthropic 投資數十億美元，Anthropic 再支付 Google 租用晶片，但資金仍不足，因此又需透過黑石等金融機構募集更多資金，以支撐持續擴張的 AI 算力需求。
除了 Google 與黑石之外，博通 (AVGO-US) 也是整體融資架構的重要角色。今年稍早，博通、黑石與阿波羅共同成立名為「AI XPV Platform」的平台，專門為大型 AI 企業提供算力基礎設施融資。市場人士指出，先前 350 億美元交易便是該平台完成的首筆大型融資案。
根據先前披露的交易架構，Google 為貸款中最高優先順位部分提供信用支持，博通則提供部分還款擔保，摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 擔任財務顧問並協助安排相關交易，凸顯華爾街正積極設計新型融資工具，以滿足 AI 產業龐大的資本需求。

Anthropic 近月來持續加速擴充算力來源，不僅依賴 Google。產業研究機構 SemiAnalysis 日前披露，Anthropic 已與 Bitdeer Technologies (BTDR-US) 及新創雲端基礎設施公司 Volta Infra 簽署一項價值 100 億美元、為期六年的算力合作協議，將透過位於挪威的資料中心部署輝達 (NVDA-US) 最新 Vera Rubin AI 平台，提供 133MW 運算容量，以支援 Claude 系列模型的訓練與推理需求。
SemiAnalysis 表示，此輪算力擴張主要受到 Claude Code 需求快速攀升帶動，企業客戶持續導入 AI 程式開發工具，使 Anthropic 必須持續增加 GPU 及 AI 晶片供應能力。
此外，Anthropic 日前也已秘密向美國監管機構提交首次公開募股 (IPO) 申請文件，市場預期公司正尋求在 OpenAI 之前完成上市。分析人士認為，持續籌措大規模債務融資，除可強化算力儲備，也有助於上市前建立更完整的基礎設施布局。
從更廣泛角度來看，AI 基礎建設正快速重塑全球信貸市場。為滿足數千億美元等級的 AI 資料中心、晶片及電力建設需求，華爾街近年持續推出大型結構融資、專案融資及私人信貸產品，吸引資產管理公司、銀行及保險資金投入。
不過，市場對 AI 投資報酬率仍存有疑慮。部分近期 AI 相關融資交易必須支付較高利率才能順利完成，反映投資人雖看好 AI 長期需求，但對龐大資本支出何時轉化為穩定現金流仍保持審慎態度。
分析人士指出，若此次 360 億美元融資最終落地，不僅將再度刷新 AI 基礎設施融資規模，也意味 Google、Anthropic 與華爾街金融機構之間的資本合作模式將進一步深化，成為 AI 時代大型算力建設的重要融資範本。
paras_en: Anthropic is continuing to expand its AI infrastructure footprint. According to Bloomberg, citing sources, Blackstone (BX-US) has begun reaching out to potential investors with a plan to lead at least a $36 billion debt financing specifically to help Anthropic pay for AI chips and related compute resources it rents from Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google. If the deal closes, it would top the roughly $35 billion AI financing transaction earlier this year and set a new record in the private‑credit market.

Sources say the new financing will follow the $35 billion private‑credit deal that Apollo Global Management (APO-US) and Blackstone arranged about two months ago. That transaction, viewed as one of the largest private‑credit deals ever, was mainly used to fund Anthropic’s rental of Google‑customized AI chips (TPUs) across five data centers.

The report notes that Google is not only a key strategic investor in Anthropic but also its primary compute supplier. In recent years Google has poured tens of billions of dollars into Anthropic, and Anthropic in turn uses that money to rent AI chips and cloud infrastructure from Google, turning part of Google’s investment back into leasing revenue – a highly watched “capital loop.”

The $36 billion financing is seen as an extension of that model. Prominent analyst and finance‑podcast host Ed Elson described the situation as Google investing tens of billions in Anthropic, Anthropic then paying Google to rent chips, yet still lacking enough cash, so it must turn to Blackstone and other financial institutions for additional capital to sustain its expanding AI compute demand.

Beyond Google and Blackstone, Broadcom (AVGO-US) also plays a key role in the overall financing structure. Earlier this year Broadcom, Blackstone and Apollo jointly created the “AI XPV Platform,” a vehicle dedicated to providing compute‑infrastructure financing for large AI firms. Market participants point out that the earlier $35 billion transaction was the platform’s first big‑ticket deal.

According to the disclosed deal structure, Google provides credit support for the most senior tranche of the loan, Broadcom supplies part of the repayment guarantee, and Morgan Stanley (MS-US) acts as financial adviser and helps arrange the transaction, highlighting Wall Street’s active design of new financing tools to meet the massive capital needs of the AI sector.

Anthropic has been accelerating its compute sourcing in recent months, not relying solely on Google. Research firm SemiAnalysis recently disclosed that Anthropic signed a six‑year, $10 billion compute partnership with Bitdeer Technologies (BTDR-US) and cloud‑infrastructure startup Volta Infra. The deal will deploy Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) latest Vera Rubin AI platform in a Norway data center, delivering 133 MW of compute capacity to support training and inference for its Claude model series.

SemiAnalysis said the compute expansion is driven by a rapid rise in demand for Claude Code, as enterprise customers adopt AI development tools, forcing Anthropic to continuously increase its GPU and AI‑chip supply capabilities.

Anthropic has also quietly filed an IPO registration with U.S. regulators, and the market expects the company to aim for a listing before OpenAI. Analysts believe that raising large‑scale debt not only strengthens its compute reserves but also helps build a more complete infrastructure foundation ahead of a public offering.

From a broader perspective, AI infrastructure is rapidly reshaping the global credit market. To meet the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar demand for AI data centers, chips and power, Wall Street has been rolling out large‑scale structured finance, project finance and private‑credit products, attracting asset managers, banks and insurers.

However, investors remain wary about AI investment returns. Some recent AI‑related financing deals have had to carry higher interest rates to close, reflecting optimism about long‑term AI demand but caution about when the huge capital outlays will translate into stable cash flow.

Analysts note that if the $36 billion financing is ultimately completed, it will not only reset the benchmark for AI infrastructure financing size but also deepen the capital partnership model among Google, Anthropic and Wall Street firms, becoming a key financing template for large‑scale compute construction in the AI era.

items.title: 比亞迪海獺殺進日本K-Car市場掀熱潮 鈴木喊「巨大威脅」
items.title_en: BYD's Sealion Makes a Splash in Japan's K-Car Market, Suzuki Calls it a 'Huge Threat'
paras: 比亞迪 (002594-CN) 憑一款微型純電車型，在日本市場掀起驚濤駭浪，徹底攪動了當地根深蒂固的汽車生態。
比亞迪針對日本市場量身打造的純電 K-Car 車型「海獺」（RACCO）正式發布，迅速引發當地社會的高度關注。日經中文網報導指出，海獺的訂單量已突破 700 台。
而日本汽車銷售產業團體數據亦顯示，該車上市僅 4 天註冊量便達到 125 台，甚至有市場傳聞稱其首周鎖單量高達 5000 台，直接完成了比亞迪在日本全年的半數銷售目標。
面對這股強勢衝擊，日本 K-Car 市場霸主鈴木汽車的社長鈴木俊宏公開坦言比亞迪已構成巨大威脅，連擔任代言人的日本國民女神廣瀨愛麗絲，也因觸及本土車企利益而遭遇諸多非議。
作為日本汽車市場的生命線，K-Car 憑藉車身小巧、便於停放、通行效率高以及專屬的稅收優惠，長期佔據日本新車銷量三成至四成的龐大市場。
然而，日本消費者長久以來缺乏越級體驗。比亞迪海獺精準切入這一核心腹地，售價約合新台幣百萬上下，卻破局性地配備了感應側滑門、NFC 手機鑰匙、電池預熱、V2L 對外放電、座椅及方向盤加熱等同級罕見的高端配置，以極具競爭力的性價比贏得了日本消費者的熱烈追捧。
這場出海大捷也引發了中國對一線城市交通與停車難題的反思。儘管中國大都市面臨嚴重的擁堵與高昂的停車成本，短途精品代步車理論上有其生存空間，但因缺乏日本獨特的政策紅利，且多數家庭仍將汽車視為兼顧長途與全家出行的唯一交通工具，微型車在短期內難以完全普及。
不過，隨著城市交通壓力的加劇，未來中國市場可望迎來結合本土路況的精品微型車風潮。
比亞迪海獺在日本的爆火，本質上是中國新能源汽車硬核實力的全球化印證，不僅打破了日系車企對本土 K-Car 市場的長期壟斷，也為中國車企出海積累了寶貴經驗。
隨著「海外驗證、返銷國內」策略的推進，這場由海獺掀起的出圈效應，正成為中國汽車工業邁向全球化的高光起點。
paras_en: BYD (002594-CN) has caused a stir in the Japanese market with its miniature pure electric car, shaking up the local automotive ecosystem. The company's pure electric K-Car model, the Sealion (RACCO), was officially released and quickly gained significant attention from the local community.

According to a report by Nikkei Chinese, the Sealion has received over 700 orders. Data from the Japanese automotive sales industry also shows that the car had 125 registrations within just four days of its release, with some market rumors suggesting that its first-week lock-in sales reached 5,000 units, thereby achieving half of BYD's annual sales target in Japan.

Facing this strong impact, Suzuki Motor Corporation's president, Toshihiro Suzuki, openly admitted that BYD poses a huge threat. Even Japanese national idol Airi Suzuki, who endorses the brand, has faced criticism for touching on the interests of domestic car companies.

As the lifeblood of the Japanese automotive market, K-Cars have long occupied a large market share of 30-40% of new car sales due to their compact size, ease of parking, high efficiency, and exclusive tax benefits.

However, Japanese consumers have long lacked a high-end experience. BYD's Sealion has accurately targeted this core area, offering advanced features such as inductive side sliding doors, NFC mobile keys, battery preheating, V2L external discharge, and heated seats and steering wheels, all at a competitive price of around NT$1 million, thereby winning the favor of Japanese consumers.

This overseas victory has also led to reflection on China's first-tier cities' traffic and parking difficulties. Although Chinese cities face severe congestion and high parking costs, short-distance, high-end commuter cars have theoretical survival space, but due to the lack of Japan's unique policy benefits and the fact that most families view cars as the only means of transportation for long-distance and family trips, micro-cars are unlikely to become widely popular in the short term.
However, as urban traffic pressure increases, the Chinese market is expected to see a trend of high-end micro-cars tailored to local road conditions in the future.

The popularity of BYD's Sealion in Japan is essentially a testament to the globalization of China's new energy automotive industry, breaking the long-term monopoly of Japanese companies in the domestic K-Car market and accumulating valuable experience for Chinese companies to expand overseas.

items.title: Meta看上衛星通訊！商業航太股趁勢起飛 AST升超10%
items.title_en: Meta Eyes AST SpaceMobile: Commercial Aviation Stocks Soar as AST Surpasses 10% Gain
paras: 受惠於 Meta(META-US)對「社群媒體 + 衛星網路」合作的興趣，商業航太股 AST SpaceMobile(ASTS-US)週二 (4 日) 大漲超過 10%，連續第四個交易日走高，公司前一日亦上漲超 7%。
除了 AST SpaceMobile，SpaceX(SPCX-US)、Rocket Lab(RKLB-US) 等商業航太股也在週二收高。
據《財聯社》，消息面上，Meta 高層週一發文稱，兩家公司探討了如何讓通訊軟體 WhatsApp 在 AST SpaceMobile 的衛星網絡上運行。
具體來說，Meta 負責網絡基礎設施全球負責人 Vinod Samarawickrama 透露，兩家公司近期在 Meta 總部舉行了一場研討會，圍繞雙方共同構想的衛星連接願景展開討論。他表示，雙方的討論重點已從「證明衛星連接技術可行」，轉向打造「一種人們真正會使用的無縫產品體驗」。
他補充道，雙方的討論並不侷限於傳統的衛星緊急通訊場景上，而是聚焦於更廣泛的消費者應用前景，包括為旅行者、遠端工作者、海事用戶，以及生活在傳統蜂窩網絡覆蓋範圍之外的人群提供語音、影像和消息服務。
他寫道：「這機會遠遠超越了緊急通訊，它的意義在於，讓人們無論身處何地，都能夠保持連接。」
這輪連漲發生之際，AST SpaceMobile 正準備發射最新一批衛星，並將衛星互聯網業務擴展至海外市場。
按照日程，公司的 BlueBird 11、12 和 13 號衛星將在美國當地時間週三凌晨，搭乘 SpaceX 的「獵鷹 9 號」火箭升空。上批 8-10 號衛星於今年 6 月成功部署。這些衛星能直接向標準、未改裝的智能手機提供語音、數據和影像服務。
AST SpaceMobile 上週曾向美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）提交文件，披露馬上將開始在日本開展 D2C（Direct-to-Cell，手機直連衛星）業務。
文件顯示，日本是 AST SpaceMobile 首個國際市場。公司將與本土營運商樂天移動（Rakuten Mobile）合作，利用其獲批頻譜開展業務，其中包括用於上行傳輸的 715-718MHz 頻段，以及用於下行通信的 770-773MHz 頻段。
AST SpaceMobile 還確認，公司已經獲得日本監管機構所需的全部授權，相關運營將遵循「不造成干擾」的原則開展；如果發生有害干擾，公司能夠立即關閉相關衛星波束。
paras_en: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS-US) surged over 10% on Tuesday, marking its fourth consecutive trading day of gains, following a 7% increase the previous day. The company's stock price has been boosted by Meta's (META-US) interest in collaborating on 'social media + satellite network' projects.
Besides AST SpaceMobile, other commercial aviation stocks such as SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Rocket Lab (RKLB-US) also closed higher on Tuesday.
According to a report by Bloomberg, Meta's top executives revealed on Monday that the company is exploring ways to enable WhatsApp to run on AST SpaceMobile's satellite network.

Meta's global head of network infrastructure, Vinod Samarawickrama, revealed that the two companies recently held a meeting at Meta's headquarters to discuss their shared vision for satellite connectivity.
Samarawickrama stated that the discussion has shifted from 'proving the feasibility of satellite connectivity' to creating 'a seamless product experience that people will actually use'.

He added that the discussion is not limited to traditional emergency communication scenarios, but rather focuses on broader consumer applications, including voice, image, and messaging services for travelers, remote workers, maritime users, and individuals living outside traditional cellular network coverage areas.
Samarawickrama wrote, 'This opportunity goes far beyond emergency communication. It's about keeping people connected, no matter where they are.'
AST SpaceMobile is preparing to launch its latest batch of satellites and expand its satellite internet business into international markets.
According to the company's schedule, its BlueBird 11, 12, and 13 satellites will be launched on Wednesday morning local time aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.
The company's previous batch of 8-10 satellites was successfully deployed in June this year. These satellites can provide voice, data, and image services directly to standard, unmodified smartphones.
AST SpaceMobile recently submitted a filing to the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC), revealing plans to launch its Direct-to-Cell (D2C) business in Japan.

The filing shows that Japan is AST SpaceMobile's first international market, and the company will partner with local operator Rakuten Mobile to launch the service, using its approved spectrum, including the 715-718MHz band for uplink transmission and the 770-773MHz band for downlink communication.

AST SpaceMobile confirmed that it has obtained all necessary authorizations from Japanese regulatory authorities and will operate in accordance with the 'no interference' principle; if harmful interference occurs, the company can immediately shut down the relevant satellite beam.

items.title: 川普擬禁中國光收發模組進口！Lumentum、Coherent飆漲  中際旭創恐受衝擊
items.title_en: Trump Aims to Ban China-Made Optical Modules, Lumentum and Coherent Soar
paras: 四名知情人士指出，川普政府正草擬一項禁令，擬禁止美國進口中國製造的新款資料中心元件，以保護支撐人工智慧（AI）熱潮的關鍵基礎設施。
根據《路透》報導，負責監管美國電信產業的美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）正研擬這項措施，禁止進口中國製造的新款光收發模組。這類元件可讓資料在資料中心內透過光纖電纜以接近光速傳輸。官員希望於今年公布該措施，並在發布後正式生效。
這項此前未曾曝光的措施，主要目的在於防範中國廠商藉由相關設備竊取資料、植入惡意軟體，或干擾容納訓練與運行 AI 模型晶片的美國資料中心運作。
消息人士強調，FCC 仍可能修改或擱置此案。不過，此舉被視為川普政府近期一連串防堵中國技術滲透美國尖端產業行動的最新案例，目的是趁相關技術尚未深植供應鏈之前先下手為強。
華府顧問公司 Beacon Global Strategies 的 AI 政策專家 Divyansh Kaushik 分析指出：「光收發模組確實存在風險。隨著資料中心建設持續擴大，必須從一開始就確保資料中心供應鏈的安全。」
市場認為，美國政府這項措施將有利於美國本土光收發模組製造商，相關消息曝光後，相關個股股價應聲走高。
週二（4 日）收盤，Lumentum(LITE-US) 、Coherent(COHR-US) 、祥茂光電科技 (AAOI-US) 與邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) 股價分別大漲 8.92%、12.35%、19.44% 與 12.81%。

中國大使館：若有必要將採取反制措施

白宮與 FCC 均未回應。中國駐美大使館則表示，北京敦促美方「傾聽兩國工商界客觀理性的聲音」，並「停止抹黑中國企業、停止以制裁相威脅」。
大使館並強調：「中國將針對任何對自身利益造成實質損害的行動，採取一切必要措施予以回應。」
若美國禁止進口中國製新款資料中心設備，預料將衝擊全球最大光收發模組供應商之一的中際旭創 (300308-CN) 。
該公司今年 6 月已被美國國防部列入涉嫌與中國軍方有關聯的企業名單，而此類名單往往被視為美方後續祭出更嚴厲制裁的前兆。中際旭創未回應置評請求。
分析指出，這項禁令也可能推高美國雲端服務業者的成本，包括亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 雲端服務（AWS）等企業，因其可能被迫改向美國廠商 Coherent 與 Lumentum 等供應商採購產品。
川普政府內部對中國立場強硬的官員，希望避免重演華為事件。當年，儘管華為受到美方嚴厲制裁，但其電信設備早已深度部署於美國基礎設施，導致後續拆除工程耗時、成本高昂，且始終無法全面完成。
FCC 過去向來被視為獨立監管機關，但美國最高法院今年 6 月支持美國總統川普撤換一名民主黨籍聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）委員，使總統對聯邦政府、包括部分獨立監管機關的人事掌控權進一步擴大。
根據 Counterpoint Research 的資料，中際旭創目前約占全球資料中心光收發模組市場 27% 市占率，居全球領先地位。
美國創新基金會（Foundation for American Innovation）的報告指出，雖然 Coherent 與 Lumentum 擁有具競爭力的技術，但目前生產規模仍不足以完全取代中國供應商。
報告也指出，中際旭創約 90% 的營收來自中國以外市場。
AWS、Coherent 與 Lumentum 均未回應置評請求。
《路透》先前報導，FCC 已陸續對中國製無人機、路由器、機器人及逆變器祭出類似限制。
三名消息人士表示，依照相同模式，FCC 將禁止所有中國製新款光收發模組進口，同時對多數非中國供應商豁免相關限制。
川普第一任期時，曾大力批評中國企業涉嫌竊取智慧財產權，並指控華為配合中國政府從事間諜活動；華為則一再否認相關指控。
不過，相較第一任期，川普第二任期對中國採取較為克制的態度，部分原因是北京去年祭出稀土出口管制措施，增加美方施壓成本。
《路透》今年 2 月曾報導，美國商務部原本研擬一系列針對中國的進口限制措施，包括限制中國資料中心設備，但在去年 10 月美中貿易戰暫時降溫後，相關措施遭到擱置。
如今 FCC 已接手推動相關限制措施，並分別於去年 12 月及今年 3 月透過國會授權建立的「受管制清單」宣布禁止中國製無人機與路由器。
該名單旨在禁止未來被認定危害美國國家安全的外國企業設備進入美國市場，而針對中國製逆變器與機器人的限制措施也已於上週陸續推出。
paras_en: Sources close to the matter say the Trump administration is drafting an order to ban the importation of China-made new-generation data center components to protect critical infrastructure supporting the AI boom.

According to a Reuters report, the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is working on this measure, which would prohibit the importation of China-made new-generation optical transceivers. These components allow data to be transmitted at near-light speed through fiber optic cables within data centers.
The move, previously unreported, aims to prevent Chinese companies from stealing data, inserting malware, or disrupting the operation of US data centers that contain AI model chips.

The FCC may still modify or put the plan on hold, but this move is seen as the latest example of the Trump administration's efforts to block Chinese technology from infiltrating the US's cutting-edge industries.

Divyansh Kaushik, an AI policy expert at Beacon Global Strategies, a Washington-based consulting firm, said: 'Optical transceivers do pose a risk. As data center construction continues to expand, it's essential to ensure the security of the data center supply chain from the start.'
The market believes that this move will benefit US-based optical transceiver manufacturers, with related stocks surging after the news broke.

On Tuesday (4th), Lumentum (LITE-US), Coherent (COHR-US), Acacia Communications (AAOI-US), and Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) saw their stock prices jump 8.92%, 12.35%, 19.44%, and 12.81%, respectively.
The Chinese embassy in the US responded by saying that if necessary, they will take countermeasures.

The White House and FCC have not commented. The Chinese embassy emphasized that Beijing urges the US to 'listen to the objective voices of the business community' and 'stop smearing Chinese companies and stop threatening them with sanctions.'
The embassy also stated that China will take 'all necessary measures' to respond to any actions that cause 'actual harm' to its interests.
If the US bans the importation of China-made new-generation data center equipment, it is expected to impact the global largest optical transceiver supplier, ZTE (300308-CN).
ZTE was listed as a company suspected of having ties to the Chinese military by the US Department of Defense in June this year. The company has not responded to a request for comment.

Analysts point out that this ban may also increase the costs of US cloud service providers, including Amazon Web Services (AMZN-US), as they may be forced to switch to US-based suppliers like Coherent and Lumentum.

Trump administration officials who are tough on China hope to avoid a repeat of the Huawei incident. Despite Huawei facing severe US sanctions, its telecommunications equipment had already been deeply embedded in US infrastructure, leading to costly and time-consuming removal efforts.

The FCC has traditionally been seen as an independent regulatory agency, but the US Supreme Court supported President Trump's decision to replace a Democratic FTC commissioner in June, giving the president greater control over personnel at federal agencies, including some independent regulatory bodies.
According to Counterpoint Research, ZTE currently holds a 27% market share in the global data center optical transceiver market, leading the global market.

A report by the Foundation for American Innovation found that while Coherent and Lumentum have competitive technologies, their production capacity is still insufficient to completely replace Chinese suppliers.
The report also noted that ZTE generates approximately 90% of its revenue from non-China markets.
AWS, Coherent, and Lumentum have not responded to requests for comment.
Reuters previously reported that the FCC has imposed similar restrictions on Chinese-made drones, routers, robots, and inverters.
Three sources said that the FCC will ban all new-generation optical transceivers made in China, while exempting most non-Chinese suppliers from the restrictions.

During his first term, Trump strongly criticized Chinese companies for allegedly stealing intellectual property and accused Huawei of collaborating with the Chinese government on espionage activities; Huawei has repeatedly denied these allegations.

However, compared to his first term, Trump's second term has taken a more restrained approach to China, partly due to Beijing's imposition of rare earth export controls last year, which increased the cost of US pressure.

Reuters reported in February that the US Commerce Department had drafted a series of import restrictions on China, including data center equipment, but the measures were put on hold after the US-China trade war cooled down in October last year.
The FCC has since taken over the push for these restrictions and has listed China-made drones and routers on the 'controlled list' established by Congress in December last year and March this year.

The list aims to prohibit foreign companies deemed to pose a threat to US national security from entering the US market. Restrictions on Chinese-made inverters and robots were also implemented last week.

items.title: 美擬封殺中國光收發器！光通訊類股集體大漲 AAOI飆近20%
items.title_en: US Considers Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers, Boosting US Telecom Stocks
paras: 美國川普政府傳出正研擬禁止進口新款中國資料中心硬體，限制範圍可能涵蓋 AI 資料中心使用的光收發器。消息帶動美國光通訊類股週二 (4 日) 全面走強，投資人預期，一旦禁令正式實施，美國供應商可望承接原本由中國業者供應的訂單。
美股週二收盤，Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) 暴漲 19.44%，Coherent (COHR-US) 急漲約 12.27%，Lumentum (LITE-US) 勁揚 8.92%，康寧 (GLW-US) 也飛升約 9%。
《路透》引述 4 名知情人士報導，美國聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 正準備對中國製造的新款光收發器實施進口限制。光收發器是 AI 資料中心的關鍵零組件，主要負責透過光纖在伺服器與網路設備之間高速傳輸資料。
美國官員擔憂，陸製光收發器可能使 AI 基礎設施面臨資料遭竊、惡意軟體植入或服務中斷等風險，因此希望在今年內完成相關規範並開始執行。不過，這項政策仍處於草擬階段，FCC 最終仍可能修改甚至放棄相關計畫。
根據知情人士透露，FCC 考慮禁止所有新型號的中國光收發器進入美國市場，同時可能向部分非中國供應商提供豁免。這種做法與 FCC 先前針對中國無人機、路由器、機器人及太陽能逆變器採取的限制措施相似。
這項政策的主要影響對象之一，是中國光通訊設備大廠中際旭創 (300308-CN)。
根據 Counterpoint Research 資料，中際旭創掌握全球資料中心光收發器市場約 27% 的市占率，並於今年 6 月被美國國防部列入被指與中國軍方有關的企業名單。
美國創新基金會的資料則顯示，中際旭創約 90% 的營收來自海外市場。若美國正式禁止進口其新款產品，公司在全球最大 AI 資料中心市場之一的業務可能面臨壓力。
對亞馬遜 AWS 等超大規模雲端服務商而言，禁令可能迫使其重新調整供應鏈，改向 Coherent、Lumentum 及其他非中國廠商採購。由於替代產品的價格與供應能力仍有不確定性，資料中心建置成本也可能因此上升。
另一方面，美國光通訊廠商可望成為供應鏈轉移的主要受惠者。市場預期，如果中國競爭對手遭到排除，Coherent、Lumentum 與 AAOI 等業者不僅可能取得更多訂單，也有機會提高產能利用率與市場議價能力。
paras_en: The US Trump administration is reportedly considering a ban on importing new Chinese data center hardware, which could include optical transceivers used in AI data centers. This news drove a broad rally in US telecom stocks on Tuesday (4th), with investors expecting that once the ban is implemented, US suppliers could gain orders that were previously supplied by Chinese companies.
US stocks closed on Tuesday with Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) surging 19.44%, Coherent (COHR-US) jumping 12.27%, Lumentum (LITE-US) rising 8.92%, and Corning (GLW-US) also soaring 9%.

According to Reuters, citing four sources familiar with the matter, the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is preparing to impose import restrictions on new Chinese-made optical transceivers. Optical transceivers are a critical component of AI data centers, responsible for high-speed data transmission between servers and network equipment via fiber optic cables.

US officials are concerned that Chinese-made optical transceivers could pose risks to AI infrastructure, including data theft, malicious software injection, or service disruptions. They hope to complete the relevant regulations and start implementing them by the end of the year. However, this policy is still in the drafting stage, and the FCC may ultimately modify or abandon the plan.

According to sources, the FCC is considering banning all new models of Chinese optical transceivers from entering the US market, while possibly granting exemptions to some non-Chinese suppliers. This approach is similar to the FCC's previous restrictions on Chinese drones, routers, robots, and solar inverters.
The main target of this policy is China's leading optical communication equipment manufacturer, Zhongtian Xingda (300308-CN).

According to data from Counterpoint Research, Zhongtian Xingda holds around 27% of the global data center optical transceiver market share. In June this year, the US Department of Defense added the company to its list of entities suspected of having ties to the Chinese military.

US Innovation Foundation data shows that around 90% of Zhongtian Xingda's revenue comes from overseas markets. If the US formally bans the import of its new products, the company's business in the world's largest AI data center market may face pressure.

For Amazon's AWS and other large-scale cloud service providers, the ban could force them to re-adjust their supply chains and switch to Coherent, Lumentum, and other non-Chinese suppliers. Due to the uncertainty surrounding the prices and supply capabilities of replacement products, data center construction costs may also rise.

On the other hand, US telecom companies may benefit from the shift in supply chains. Market expectations are that if Chinese competitors are excluded, Coherent, Lumentum, and AAOI, among others, may gain more orders, increase their production utilization rates, and enhance their market bargaining power.

items.title: 白宮發布多條帖文 擅自使用日本動畫素材
items.title_en: White House Posts Unauthorized Anime Content in Social Media
paras: 據日本《每日新聞》4 日（周二）報導，美國白宮在社交媒體上宣傳有關打擊伊朗、應對非法移民等政策時，多次未經許可使用《寶可夢》、《火影忍者》、《遊戲王》、《龍珠》等日本動漫素材，日本外務省已分別於今年 4 月和 6 月向美國駐日大使館提出交涉。
日方表示，即便是政府機關，使用知識產權作品也必須事先獲創作者許可，相關行為可能侵犯著作權，損害作品形象。
美方稱會把日方意見上報政府，但截至 7 月底，相關帖文仍然沒有刪除。
早在 2025 年 9 月，美國國土安全部就發布了一段打擊非法移民的影片，裡面不僅直接使用《寶可夢》的畫面，還套用「全部抓住」的標語，把非法移民的面部照片做成類似《寶可夢》卡牌的樣子。
今年 3 月，美方對伊朗採取軍事行動後，白宮賬號又把軍事行動畫面和《遊戲王》等素材剪在一起，並配文「美式正義」。《遊戲王》官方隨後發文澄清從未授權相關內容。
川普又在 6 月發布一段 AI 生成影片，出現了他化身《火影忍者》主角的畫面，日本政府因此再次向美方交涉。
白宮一系列帖文引發日本動漫愛好者強烈不滿。超過 2.3 萬人簽署在線請願，呼籲對侵犯版權的人採取行動。日本政府人士則表示，美國過去長期強調知識產權保護，如今卻在政策宣傳中忽視原則。
paras_en: According to a report by Japan's Daily News on April 4, the White House has repeatedly used Japanese anime materials such as Pokémon, Naruto, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Dragon Ball in its social media posts to promote policies on combating Iran and dealing with illegal immigration without permission.
The Japanese government has separately lodged protests with the US Embassy in Japan in April and June this year.

The Japanese side pointed out that even government agencies must obtain permission from the creators before using copyrighted works, and that such behavior may infringe on copyrights and damage the image of the works.
The US side said it would report the Japanese side's opinions to the government, but as of July 31, the relevant posts have not been deleted.

As early as September 2025, the US Department of Homeland Security released a video to combat illegal immigration, which not only directly used Pokémon's scenes but also used the slogan 'catch them all' and made the faces of illegal immigrants look like Pokémon cards.

In March this year, after the US military took military action against Iran, the White House account again cut together the scenes of the military action and the materials of Yu-Gi-Oh! and other anime, with the caption 'American justice'.
The official account of Yu-Gi-Oh! later clarified that it had never authorized the relevant content.
Trump also released a video generated by AI in June, which showed him transformed into the main character of Naruto, prompting the Japanese government to protest again.

The White House's series of posts has sparked strong dissatisfaction among Japanese anime fans, with over 23,000 people signing an online petition calling for action against those who infringe on copyrights.
Japanese government officials also pointed out that the US has long emphasized the importance of intellectual property protection, but has ignored the principle in its policy promotion.

items.title: 三星FMS亮劍：公布全新3D記憶體路線圖 zHBM性能喊話達HBM5八倍 力爭在AI技術領域領跑
items.title_en: Samsung FMS Unveils zHBM: New 3D Memory Roadmap zHBM Performance Claims 8x HBM5, Chasing AI Leadership
paras: 三星電子在美國聖克拉拉舉行的 FMS 峰會上一口氣發布 zHBM、zNAND-O 兩款概念產品，以及業界首款堆疊超 400 層的 V10 BV-NAND，正面迎戰 SK 海力士與美光，試圖在 AI 時代重奪記憶體話語權。
zHBM 最受矚目，徹底顛覆現行 2.5D 封裝架構，不再將 HBM 與 AI 晶片並排於矽中介層上，而是直接垂直堆疊在加速器上方。
三星在 FMS 峰會上宣稱，藉由晶圓鍵合技術大幅縮短數據路徑，zHBM 性能可達下一代 HBM5 的 8 倍，記憶體密度超 10 倍，能效提升 3 倍，熱阻降低逾 50%，並支援客製化 IP 嵌入，預計 2029 年量產。
與此同時，三星透露今年 2 月已率先以 1c DRAM 製程與 4 奈米基底裸片量產 HBM4，5 月向客戶交付 HBM4E 樣品。
針對邊緣 AI 場景，三星推出 zNAND-O，定位與 SK 海力士、閃迪聯合發布的 HBF 形成差異。HBF 主攻伺服器端填補 HBM 與 SSD 間的分層空缺，zNAND-O 則鎖定端側大模型存儲，透過 TSV 與 UCIe 接口，實現高空間效率、低延遲與高 I/O 性能，預計 2028 年量產。
至於 V10 BV-NAND，距 2013 年首發 V-NAND 已過 13 年，三星首次導入晶圓鍵合架構，堆疊層數突破 400 層，存儲密度較 V9 提升 58%，讀寫與 I/O 性能全面優化，為 AI 系統提供高密度 NAND 支撐。
三星還展示全棧布局：LPDDR5X-PIM 為業界首款內建存算一體的 LPDDR 記憶體；企業級 PM1763、BM1773 則瞄準 AI 資料中心記憶體需求。
作為全球唯一同時掌握記憶體、晶圓代工與先進封裝的 IDM，三星意圖以一站式方案縮短客戶開發周期，在 AI 基礎設施賽道拉開與對手的身位差距，市場將關注這些「願景型」技術能否如期落地，並轉化為實質市場份額。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics unveiled its zHBM and zNAND-O concept products, as well as the industry's first stacked over 400-layer V10 BV-NAND, at the FMS conference in San Clara, USA. This move aims to challenge SK Hynix and Micron in the AI era and regain its dominance in the memory market.

zHBM is the most attention-grabbing product, completely revolutionizing the existing 2.5D packaging architecture. Unlike HBM and AI chips being placed side by side on the silicon interlayer, zHBM is vertically stacked on top of the accelerator.

Samsung claims that by using wafer bonding technology, the data path is significantly shortened, and zHBM performance can reach 8 times that of the next-generation HBM5, with a memory density over 10 times, a 3-fold increase in efficiency, and a heat resistance reduction of over 50%. It also supports customized IP insertion and is expected to be mass-produced in 2029.
At the same time, Samsung revealed that it had already produced HBM4 using a 1c DRAM process and a 4-nanometer bare wafer in February this year, and delivered HBM4E samples to customers in May.

For the edge AI scenario, Samsung launched zNAND-O, which is positioned to differentiate itself from SK Hynix and SanDisk's joint release of HBF. HBF targets server-side filling of the layered gap between HBM and SSD, while zNAND-O focuses on end-side large model storage, achieving high spatial efficiency, low latency, and high I/O performance through TSV and UCIe interfaces, with mass production expected in 2028.

As for V10 BV-NAND, it has been 13 years since the first V-NAND was released in 2013. Samsung has introduced wafer bonding architecture for the first time, stacking over 400 layers, with a 58% increase in storage density compared to V9, and comprehensive optimization of read-write and I/O performance, providing high-density NAND support for AI systems.

Samsung also showcased its full-stack layout: LPDDR5X-PIM is the industry's first LPDDR memory with built-in storage and computing; enterprise-level PM1763 and BM1773 are targeting AI data center memory needs.

As the world's only IDM that simultaneously controls memory, wafer foundry, and advanced packaging, Samsung aims to shorten customer development cycles with a one-stop solution and create a gap in the AI infrastructure market. The market will be watching to see if these 'visionary' technologies can be implemented as planned and converted into actual market share.

items.title_en: Taipei City Sees Increase in Property Transactions in July
paras: 台北市地政局公布 2026 年 7 月建物買賣移轉棟數，全市買賣移轉棟數為 2,352 棟，較去年同期增加 13.5%，較 6 月增加 17.5%；統計顯示，內湖區、萬華區、大安區、信義區、松山區、南港區登記棟數月增率都在 20% 以上。
台北市相較於台灣其他五都房市表現，台北市 2026 年 7 月的交易量年增率為 13.5%，高於六都平均值 8.8%，月增率 17.5%，高於六都平均值 12%。而累計台北市今年 1-7 月總移轉數 14,340 棟，較去年同期增加 3.8%。
台北市不動產仲介公會理事長蘇金城今 (5) 日指出，近期台股站上歷史高點，介於 4-5 萬點間，部分高獲利投資人居高思危，部分資金轉入房市，致使 7 月買氣維持穩定；下半年即將進入年底選舉熱戰期，預料政策利空有機會趨緩，甚至期待能出現解除限制購置第二屋。
台北市年 1-7 月移轉登記棟數來看，總計交易 14,340 棟，為 2017 年以來的第 3 位低，較 110 年 1-7 月的最高點減少 22.2%。自台灣央行 2024 年 9 月實施第七波信用管制以來，買氣已經持續低迷 22 個月，整體交易量仍處於相對低谷，不少房仲業者為維持營運，將業務範圍擴及包租代管業。
蘇金城表示，2026 月交易量看似平穩，但仍處於交易量相對低檔，購屋貸款限制雖稍有鬆綁，但對提升買氣效益不大，雖有少數股市獲利轉投房市，但尚不足支撐市場買氣。

而以各行政區 7 月來看，市中心區買氣較為熱絡，內湖區、萬華區、大安區、信義區、松山區、南港區登記棟數月增率都在 2 成以上；市郊區域北投區、士林區、文山區相對偏弱勢。其中較為特別的是南港區，月增率 34.7%，年增率 1.52 倍，主要在近期半導體類股大漲，新興科技業集中的區域，獲利轉投房市效應較為明顯，內湖區月增率也達 40.2%，且買方年齡普遍低於 40 歲，部分年輕的科技新貴選擇購屋分散投資風險。
蘇金城指出，最近股市上下劇烈震盪，個股有的下跌後漲回來，也有下跌後漲不回，操作難度升高，投資人的風險意識也跟著提升，獲利轉出至房地產的機率大增；再加上政策利空應已出盡，甚至可以期待選舉利多釋出，房地產買氣可望持續加溫，因此他預料下半年整體買氣應會優於上半年。但金融市場瞬息萬變，要戒慎看待，慎防股市風暴對房地產帶來負面影響。
paras_en: According to the Taipei City Department of Land Administration, the number of building transactions in July 2026 was 2,352, a 13.5% increase from the same period last year and a 17.5% increase from June. The districts with the highest monthly growth rate, all above 20%, were Neihu, Wanhua, Daan, Xinyi, Songshan, and Nangang.

Compared to other major cities in Taiwan, Taipei City's transaction volume in July 2026 had a year-over-year growth rate of 13.5%, higher than the average of 8.8% for the six major cities, and a month-over-month growth rate of 17.5%, higher than the average of 12% for the six major cities. The total number of transactions in Taipei City from January to July was 14,340, a 3.8% increase from the same period last year.

Su Jincheng, chairman of the Taipei City Real Estate Agents Association, stated that with the Taiwan stock market reaching a historic high, some high-earning investors are diversifying their investments, leading to a stable buying atmosphere in the property market in July. As the year-end election approaches, policies may become more favorable, and the restriction on purchasing a second home may be lifted.

From January to July, the total number of transactions in Taipei City was 14,340, the third-lowest since 2017, a 22.2% decrease from the highest point in 2017. Since the central bank implemented the seventh wave of credit control in September 2024, the buying atmosphere has been low for 22 months, and the overall transaction volume is still at a relatively low level. Many real estate agents have expanded their business to include rental and property management to maintain operations.

Su Jincheng noted that although the transaction volume in July seemed stable, it was still at a relatively low level. The relaxation of purchase loan restrictions had a limited effect on boosting buying atmosphere, and the number of stock market investors transferring their gains to the property market was not enough to support the market's buying atmosphere.

Looking at each administrative district in July, the city center districts had more active buying atmosphere, with Neihu, Wanhua, Daan, Xinyi, Songshan, and Nangang districts all having a monthly growth rate above 20%. The suburban districts of Beitou, Shilin, and Wenshan were relatively weaker. Notably, Nangang district had a monthly growth rate of 34.7% and a year-over-year growth rate of 1.52 times, mainly due to the recent surge in semiconductor stocks and the concentration of new technology industries in the area, leading to a significant effect of gains being invested in the property market.

Su Jincheng pointed out that the recent fluctuations in the stock market have increased the difficulty of investment and the risk awareness of investors, leading to a higher likelihood of gains being transferred to the real estate market. With the expected release of positive policies after the election, the buying atmosphere in the property market is expected to continue to warm up. However, the financial market is highly unpredictable, and caution is needed to prevent the negative impact of a stock market storm on the property market.

paras: 這幾天，大家都在問同一個問題：「外資手裡握著快 9 萬口的期貨空單，台股是不是要反彈結束？我是不是該趕快出清逃命？」2008 年金融海嘯、2020 年疫情股災，大家都曾經歷過，因此只要看到「外資空單創高」，很多人第一個反應就是：「是不是該先跑？」
但市場真正賺錢的人，往往不是反應最快的人，而是最懂得分辨「避險」與「看空」差別的人。
外資 9 萬口空單，不一定代表看空台股
很多人看到「9 萬口空單」就聯想到 2008 年金融海嘯，心裡想著外資要幹大事了。但事實上，股市運作遠比你想的複雜。如果你只看單一數字，就會被主力的障眼法蒙蔽。
這 9 萬口空單，真正的身份主要是「美日利差交易（Carry Trade）」的避險需求與期現貨正價差的套利鎖單。簡單說，近期日本與美國利差變動，加上市場對 AI 估值進行微調，外資必須在亞洲股市做出相對應的部位對沖。這就像你出國旅遊怕意外買保險一樣，這空單是外資為了保護手裡龐大的現貨部位而買的保險，絕非單純看壞台股崩盤。
判斷真正的多空危機要看「三大風險指標」：

美元指數：已跌破 100 關卡，通膨壓力顯著緩和。
原油價格：大幅回落，市場對美聯儲升息的預期轉弱。
VIX 恐慌指數：最關鍵的指標不但沒衝破 20 紅燈警報，還維持在 15.8 左右的平穩區間。


當這三個風險指標通通沒發出紅燈警告時，外資的空單就只是標準的防禦與套利，而不是大崩盤的預告！
第三季值得關注的九檔成長股
華邦電 (2344-TW)
受惠記憶體報價改善與 AI 需求回升，產品布局涵蓋 NOR Flash、DRAM 等利基市場。成本控制逐步改善，景氣循環向上時獲利彈性相對突出。
南亞科 (2408-TW)
DDR4、DDR5 價格改善有助毛利率回升。擁有自主 DRAM 技術與大型產能優勢，是台灣少數具完整記憶體製造能力的廠商，景氣復甦時獲利改善空間大。
深耕磷化銦雷射晶片多年，是高速光通訊核心供應商。受惠 CPO 與 800G、1.6T 升級趨勢，技術門檻高，具全球競爭優勢。
主力產品涵蓋高速光纖元件與連接器，已切入國際資料中心供應鏈。AI 高速傳輸需求增加，帶動產品組合升級與獲利成長。
IET-KY(4971-TW)
專注化合物半導體 MBE 磊晶技術，產品應用於光通訊、衛星與國防。技術壁壘高、客製化能力強，具利基市場定價能力。
環宇 - KY(4991-TW)
提供砷化鎵、磷化銦晶圓代工服務，受惠光通訊與 AI 高速傳輸需求。近年營運自谷底回升，高附加價值產品比重提升。
華星光 (4979-TW)
布局高速光收發模組多年，受惠 AI 資料中心升級需求。與國際客戶合作深化，產能利用率提升，帶動營運成長。
AI 伺服器散熱龍頭，液冷與均熱板技術領先。隨 GPU 功耗持續提升，高階散熱需求快速增加，形成長期競爭護城河。
均熱片、散熱模組及導線架技術深厚，高精密製程門檻高。長期受惠 AI 伺服器、高效能運算需求，獲利成長具持續性。
結論：外資 9 萬口空單固然值得觀察，但真正決定台股下一步的，仍是企業獲利、全球資金流向，以及 AI 產業持續擴大的資本支出。
如果你手上的持股是弱勢股、沒有基本面，那趁著反彈趕快換股；換到像上面 9 檔一樣，像記憶體、散熱、CPO 這些具備長期大成長動能的標的。

paras_en: Recently, everyone has been asking the same question: "With foreign investors holding around 90,000 contracts of futures, will the Taiwan stock market rebound or collapse? Should I sell my stocks and run?"

The 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 pandemic have left us with a sense of déjà vu. Whenever we see "foreign investors holding a record-high number of futures contracts," many people immediately think, "Is it time to sell and run?"
However, the people who make money in the market are not always the ones who react the fastest. They are often the ones who can distinguish between "hedging" and "bearish" strategies.
The 90,000 contracts of futures held by foreign investors do not necessarily mean they are bearish on the Taiwan stock market.
Many people associate the number 90,000 with the 2008 financial crisis and think that foreign investors are preparing for a big event. However, the stock market is much more complex than that.
If you only look at a single number, you will be misled by the majority's herd mentality.
The 90,000 contracts of futures are primarily used for "carry trade" hedging and arbitrage between spot and futures prices.

In simple terms, the recent changes in interest rates in Japan and the US, combined with the market's adjustment of AI valuations, have forced foreign investors to make corresponding adjustments in Asian stock markets.

This is like buying insurance when traveling abroad to avoid unexpected events. These futures contracts are a form of insurance that foreign investors have bought to protect their massive inventory positions, not a simple bet on the Taiwan stock market's collapse.
To determine whether there is a true bearish or bullish crisis, we need to look at the "three major risk indicators":
The US dollar index has fallen below 100, significantly reducing inflation pressure.
Oil prices have plummeted, and market expectations of a Fed rate hike have weakened.
The VIX fear index, the most critical indicator, has not broken through the 20 warning threshold and remains in a stable range of around 15.8.
When all three risk indicators are green, foreign investors' futures contracts are simply a standard form of hedging and arbitrage, not a warning of a market collapse.

With a long history of specializing in phosphorus indium laser chips, Unity is a core supplier of high-speed optical communication components.
Benefiting from the CPO and 800G/1.6T upgrade trends, Unity's technology has a high barrier to entry and a strong global competitive advantage.
Unimicron Technology (6442-TW)
The company's main products include high-speed optical fiber components and connectors, and it has entered the international data center supply chain.
The increasing demand for AI high-speed transmission has driven the company's product lineup upgrade and profitability growth.
IET-KY (4971-TW)
Specializing in compound semiconductor MBE epitaxy technology, IET-KY's products are used in optical communication, satellite, and defense applications.
The company has a high technological barrier and strong customization capabilities, giving it a strong position in niche markets.
Unimicron Technology (4991-TW)
Providing GaAs and InP wafer foundry services, Unimicron benefits from the increasing demand for optical communication and AI high-speed transmission.

Walsin Technology (4979-TW)

With international customers, the company has deepened its cooperation and has seen an increase in production utilization rates, driving its operating growth.
Thermal Technology (3017-TW)

With the continuous increase in GPU power consumption, high-end heat dissipation demand has grown rapidly, creating a long-term competitive moat.
Thermal Technology (3653-TW)

With a high degree of precision in its manufacturing process, the company has a strong position in AI servers and high-performance computing applications.

Conclusion: While the 90,000 contracts of futures held by foreign investors are worth watching, the next step for the Taiwan stock market will ultimately be determined by corporate profitability, global capital flows, and the continued growth of AI industry capital expenditures.

If you hold weak stocks with no fundamental value, it's time to switch to stocks like the 9 growth stocks mentioned above, which have a strong potential for long-term growth in the CPO, memory, and heat dissipation sectors.

items.title: 「果鏈」備貨旺季揭幕 鴻海等代工廠招工忙
items.title_en: Foxconn and Other Contract Manufacturers Gear Up for Peak Season
paras: 時序進入 8 月，消費電子市場迎來新品發表季，以蘋果 (AAPL-US) 新一代產品為核心驅動，整個「果鏈」上下游加快了「招兵買馬」的節奏，為產能爬坡做足準備。
與往年相比，今年的產業旺季不僅體現在一線工人的規模化招募，鴻海 (2317-TW) 等龍頭代工廠在工程師崗位上也在不斷擴充。
此外，資本市場與供應鏈上下游正密切關注蘋果首款折疊機的進展，藍思科技、精研科技等產業龍頭企業已密集進入研發攻關、產能擴建與量產交付的關鍵階段。
據《上海證券報》5 日（周三）報導，每年 8 月至 12 月是 iPhone 系列產品的出貨高峰期，也是產業旺季。目前以鴻海為主的代工廠已進入招工高峰期。
8 月 4 日上午，在鄭州航空港雍州路與始祖路交叉口東北角的鴻海鄭州綜保園區招募中心外，鴻海廠區門口再次排起了長隊，拖著行李箱的年輕人從各地趕來，像候鳥一樣走進這一製造工廠。
「目前生產線用工需求快速增長，工人時薪漲到（人民幣，下同）28 元。」據鄭州富士康招工仲介介紹，鄭州富士康的用工需求主要集中在產品組裝、測試、質檢等基礎崗位，綜合月收入約 5,000 元，選擇返費工模式，在職滿 90 天後最高可獲 8,200 元獎金。
該人士說，預計 8 月 10 日左右會進入用工高峰，薪資激勵政策有望進一步加碼。
今年鴻海的招聘計畫出現大量高規格的工程師崗位。在鴻海官方招聘軟體「我要聘」上，自動化導入、射頻分析、多軸控制軟體開發、SQE、現場 IE、PE 等工程師崗位也在集中釋放。
值得關注的是，部分崗位明確提到 AI 輔助控制軟體開發者、AR/VR 眼鏡相關工作經驗者優先，薪資待遇面議。
此外，鴻海 2026 屆校園招聘也同步涵蓋了大數據、雲端運算、平台開發、AI、軟硬體研發等前沿方向，可望為長期技術轉型儲備人才。
與此同時，立訊精密 (02475-HK) 等公司也在同步招聘，崗位包括普工、研發工程師等。昆山立訊發布消息，稱錦溪園區目前獎金最高 4,500 元。上海昌碩人力資源平台近日發布招聘通知，宣布 8 月至 10 月小時工時薪為 27 元，月綜合工資在 4,800 元至 5,500 元。
paras_en: As the calendar enters August, the consumer electronics market is gearing up for the new product launch season, with Apple's (AAPL-US) new generation products at the core, driving the entire 'fruit chain' upstream and downstream to accelerate the pace of recruitment and capacity expansion.

Compared to previous years, this year's industry peak season is not only reflected in the large-scale recruitment of frontline workers, but also in the continuous expansion of engineering positions by industry leaders such as Foxconn (2317-TW).

In addition, the capital market and the supply chain upstream and downstream are closely watching the progress of Apple's first foldable phone, with industry leaders such as Bluesight Technology and Precision Technology already intensively entering the research and development, capacity expansion, and mass delivery stages.

According to a report by the Shanghai Securities News on August 5 (Wednesday), the period from August to December every year is the peak period for iPhone series product shipments, and it is also the peak season for the industry. Currently, Foxconn-led contract manufacturers have entered the peak recruitment period.

On August 4, in the morning, at the intersection of Yongzhou Road and Shizu Road in Zhengzhou Aviation Port, the recruitment center outside the Foxconn Zhengzhou Comprehensive Park in the northeast corner was again lined up with young people from all over the country, carrying luggage, like migratory birds, entering this manufacturing factory.

"Currently, the production line's labor demand is growing rapidly, and the hourly wage has risen to 28 yuan (CNY)." According to an introduction by a recruitment intermediary in Zhengzhou, Foxconn's labor demand in Zhengzhou is mainly concentrated in product assembly, testing, and quality inspection positions, with a comprehensive monthly income of around 5,000 yuan. They offer a return fee mode, and after working for 90 days, the highest possible bonus is 8,200 yuan.
The person said that it is expected to enter the peak recruitment period around August 10, and the salary incentive policy may be further increased.

This year, Foxconn's recruitment plan has appeared with a large number of high-specification engineering positions. On Foxconn's official recruitment software, "I Want to Hire", automation introduction, frequency analysis, multi-axis control software development, SQE, field IE, and PE positions are also being released in batches.

Worth noting is that some positions explicitly mention that AI-assisted control software developers and AR/VR glasses-related work experience are given priority, and the salary and benefits are negotiable.

In addition, Foxconn's 2026 campus recruitment also covers frontier directions such as big data, cloud computing, platform development, AI, and software and hardware research and development, which can reserve talent for long-term technical transformation.

At the same time, companies such as Litespeed Precision (02475-HK) are also recruiting in sync, with positions including general workers and research and development engineers. Kunshan Litespeed has announced that the highest bonus in the Jinxi Garden area is 4,500 yuan. Shanghai Changshuo Human Resources Platform has recently published a recruitment notice, announcing that the hourly wage from August to October is 27 yuan, and the monthly comprehensive income is between 4,800 yuan and 5,500 yuan.

items.title: 黑石擬籌360億美元助Anthropic租晶片 AI融資閉環再擴大
items.title_en: Blackstone Plans $36 B Debt Deal to Help Anthropic Rent AI Chips, Expanding AI Financing Loop
paras: Anthropic 正持續擴大 AI 基礎設施布局。根據《彭博》引述知情人士報導，黑石集團 (BX-US) 已開始與潛在投資人接觸，計劃牽頭安排至少 360 億美元債務融資，專門協助 Anthropic 支付向 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 租用 AI 晶片與相關運算資源的費用。若交易順利完成，將超越今年稍早規模約 350 億美元的 AI 融資案，再度刷新私人信貸市場紀錄。
消息人士指出，這筆新融資將延續約兩個月前由阿波羅全球管理 (APO-US) 與黑石共同安排的 350 億美元私人信貸交易。該交易被市場視為史上規模最大的私人信貸案之一，主要用於支應 Anthropic 在五座資料中心租用 Google 客製化 AI 晶片 (TPU) 所需資金。
報導指出，Google 不僅是 Anthropic 的重要策略投資人，也是其主要算力供應商。Google 近年已向 Anthropic 投入數十億美元資金，而 Anthropic 再利用這些資金向 Google 租用 AI 晶片與雲端基礎設施，使 Google 的投資部分回流為租賃收入，形成市場高度關注的「資金閉環」(capital loop)。
此次 360 億美元融資也被視為上述模式的進一步延伸。知名分析師兼金融 Podcast 主持人 Ed Elson 形容，Google 向 Anthropic 投資數十億美元，Anthropic 再支付 Google 租用晶片，但資金仍不足，因此又需透過黑石等金融機構募集更多資金，以支撐持續擴張的 AI 算力需求。
除了 Google 與黑石之外，博通 (AVGO-US) 也是整體融資架構的重要角色。今年稍早，博通、黑石與阿波羅共同成立名為「AI XPV Platform」的平台，專門為大型 AI 企業提供算力基礎設施融資。市場人士指出，先前 350 億美元交易便是該平台完成的首筆大型融資案。
根據先前披露的交易架構，Google 為貸款中最高優先順位部分提供信用支持，博通則提供部分還款擔保，摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 擔任財務顧問並協助安排相關交易，凸顯華爾街正積極設計新型融資工具，以滿足 AI 產業龐大的資本需求。

Anthropic 近月來持續加速擴充算力來源，不僅依賴 Google。產業研究機構 SemiAnalysis 日前披露，Anthropic 已與 Bitdeer Technologies (BTDR-US) 及新創雲端基礎設施公司 Volta Infra 簽署一項價值 100 億美元、為期六年的算力合作協議，將透過位於挪威的資料中心部署輝達 (NVDA-US) 最新 Vera Rubin AI 平台，提供 133MW 運算容量，以支援 Claude 系列模型的訓練與推理需求。
SemiAnalysis 表示，此輪算力擴張主要受到 Claude Code 需求快速攀升帶動，企業客戶持續導入 AI 程式開發工具，使 Anthropic 必須持續增加 GPU 及 AI 晶片供應能力。
此外，Anthropic 日前也已秘密向美國監管機構提交首次公開募股 (IPO) 申請文件，市場預期公司正尋求在 OpenAI 之前完成上市。分析人士認為，持續籌措大規模債務融資，除可強化算力儲備，也有助於上市前建立更完整的基礎設施布局。
從更廣泛角度來看，AI 基礎建設正快速重塑全球信貸市場。為滿足數千億美元等級的 AI 資料中心、晶片及電力建設需求，華爾街近年持續推出大型結構融資、專案融資及私人信貸產品，吸引資產管理公司、銀行及保險資金投入。
不過，市場對 AI 投資報酬率仍存有疑慮。部分近期 AI 相關融資交易必須支付較高利率才能順利完成，反映投資人雖看好 AI 長期需求，但對龐大資本支出何時轉化為穩定現金流仍保持審慎態度。
分析人士指出，若此次 360 億美元融資最終落地，不僅將再度刷新 AI 基礎設施融資規模，也意味 Google、Anthropic 與華爾街金融機構之間的資本合作模式將進一步深化，成為 AI 時代大型算力建設的重要融資範本。
paras_en: Anthropic is continuing to expand its AI infrastructure footprint. According to Bloomberg, citing sources, Blackstone (BX-US) has begun reaching out to potential investors with a plan to lead at least a $36 billion debt financing specifically to help Anthropic pay for AI chips and related compute resources it rents from Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google. If the deal closes, it would top the roughly $35 billion AI financing transaction earlier this year and set a new record in the private‑credit market.

Sources say the new financing will follow the $35 billion private‑credit deal that Apollo Global Management (APO-US) and Blackstone arranged about two months ago. That transaction, viewed as one of the largest private‑credit deals ever, was mainly used to fund Anthropic’s rental of Google‑customized AI chips (TPUs) across five data centers.

The report notes that Google is not only a key strategic investor in Anthropic but also its primary compute supplier. In recent years Google has poured tens of billions of dollars into Anthropic, and Anthropic in turn uses that money to rent AI chips and cloud infrastructure from Google, turning part of Google’s investment back into leasing revenue – a highly watched “capital loop.”

The $36 billion financing is seen as an extension of that model. Prominent analyst and finance‑podcast host Ed Elson described the situation as Google investing tens of billions in Anthropic, Anthropic then paying Google to rent chips, yet still lacking enough cash, so it must turn to Blackstone and other financial institutions for additional capital to sustain its expanding AI compute demand.

Beyond Google and Blackstone, Broadcom (AVGO-US) also plays a key role in the overall financing structure. Earlier this year Broadcom, Blackstone and Apollo jointly created the “AI XPV Platform,” a vehicle dedicated to providing compute‑infrastructure financing for large AI firms. Market participants point out that the earlier $35 billion transaction was the platform’s first big‑ticket deal.

According to the disclosed deal structure, Google provides credit support for the most senior tranche of the loan, Broadcom supplies part of the repayment guarantee, and Morgan Stanley (MS-US) acts as financial adviser and helps arrange the transaction, highlighting Wall Street’s active design of new financing tools to meet the massive capital needs of the AI sector.

Anthropic has been accelerating its compute sourcing in recent months, not relying solely on Google. Research firm SemiAnalysis recently disclosed that Anthropic signed a six‑year, $10 billion compute partnership with Bitdeer Technologies (BTDR-US) and cloud‑infrastructure startup Volta Infra. The deal will deploy Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) latest Vera Rubin AI platform in a Norway data center, delivering 133 MW of compute capacity to support training and inference for its Claude model series.

SemiAnalysis said the compute expansion is driven by a rapid rise in demand for Claude Code, as enterprise customers adopt AI development tools, forcing Anthropic to continuously increase its GPU and AI‑chip supply capabilities.

Anthropic has also quietly filed an IPO registration with U.S. regulators, and the market expects the company to aim for a listing before OpenAI. Analysts believe that raising large‑scale debt not only strengthens its compute reserves but also helps build a more complete infrastructure foundation ahead of a public offering.

From a broader perspective, AI infrastructure is rapidly reshaping the global credit market. To meet the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar demand for AI data centers, chips and power, Wall Street has been rolling out large‑scale structured finance, project finance and private‑credit products, attracting asset managers, banks and insurers.

However, investors remain wary about AI investment returns. Some recent AI‑related financing deals have had to carry higher interest rates to close, reflecting optimism about long‑term AI demand but caution about when the huge capital outlays will translate into stable cash flow.

Analysts note that if the $36 billion financing is ultimately completed, it will not only reset the benchmark for AI infrastructure financing size but also deepen the capital partnership model among Google, Anthropic and Wall Street firms, becoming a key financing template for large‑scale compute construction in the AI era.

items.title: Meta看上衛星通訊！商業航太股趁勢起飛 AST升超10%
items.title_en: Meta Eyes AST SpaceMobile: Commercial Aviation Stocks Soar as AST Surpasses 10% Gain
paras: 受惠於 Meta(META-US)對「社群媒體 + 衛星網路」合作的興趣，商業航太股 AST SpaceMobile(ASTS-US)週二 (4 日) 大漲超過 10%，連續第四個交易日走高，公司前一日亦上漲超 7%。
除了 AST SpaceMobile，SpaceX(SPCX-US)、Rocket Lab(RKLB-US) 等商業航太股也在週二收高。
據《財聯社》，消息面上，Meta 高層週一發文稱，兩家公司探討了如何讓通訊軟體 WhatsApp 在 AST SpaceMobile 的衛星網絡上運行。
具體來說，Meta 負責網絡基礎設施全球負責人 Vinod Samarawickrama 透露，兩家公司近期在 Meta 總部舉行了一場研討會，圍繞雙方共同構想的衛星連接願景展開討論。他表示，雙方的討論重點已從「證明衛星連接技術可行」，轉向打造「一種人們真正會使用的無縫產品體驗」。
他補充道，雙方的討論並不侷限於傳統的衛星緊急通訊場景上，而是聚焦於更廣泛的消費者應用前景，包括為旅行者、遠端工作者、海事用戶，以及生活在傳統蜂窩網絡覆蓋範圍之外的人群提供語音、影像和消息服務。
他寫道：「這機會遠遠超越了緊急通訊，它的意義在於，讓人們無論身處何地，都能夠保持連接。」
這輪連漲發生之際，AST SpaceMobile 正準備發射最新一批衛星，並將衛星互聯網業務擴展至海外市場。
按照日程，公司的 BlueBird 11、12 和 13 號衛星將在美國當地時間週三凌晨，搭乘 SpaceX 的「獵鷹 9 號」火箭升空。上批 8-10 號衛星於今年 6 月成功部署。這些衛星能直接向標準、未改裝的智能手機提供語音、數據和影像服務。
AST SpaceMobile 上週曾向美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）提交文件，披露馬上將開始在日本開展 D2C（Direct-to-Cell，手機直連衛星）業務。
文件顯示，日本是 AST SpaceMobile 首個國際市場。公司將與本土營運商樂天移動（Rakuten Mobile）合作，利用其獲批頻譜開展業務，其中包括用於上行傳輸的 715-718MHz 頻段，以及用於下行通信的 770-773MHz 頻段。
AST SpaceMobile 還確認，公司已經獲得日本監管機構所需的全部授權，相關運營將遵循「不造成干擾」的原則開展；如果發生有害干擾，公司能夠立即關閉相關衛星波束。
paras_en: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS-US) surged over 10% on Tuesday, marking its fourth consecutive trading day of gains, following a 7% increase the previous day. The company's stock price has been boosted by Meta's (META-US) interest in collaborating on 'social media + satellite network' projects.
Besides AST SpaceMobile, other commercial aviation stocks such as SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Rocket Lab (RKLB-US) also closed higher on Tuesday.
According to a report by Bloomberg, Meta's top executives revealed on Monday that the company is exploring ways to enable WhatsApp to run on AST SpaceMobile's satellite network.

Meta's global head of network infrastructure, Vinod Samarawickrama, revealed that the two companies recently held a meeting at Meta's headquarters to discuss their shared vision for satellite connectivity.
Samarawickrama stated that the discussion has shifted from 'proving the feasibility of satellite connectivity' to creating 'a seamless product experience that people will actually use'.

He added that the discussion is not limited to traditional emergency communication scenarios, but rather focuses on broader consumer applications, including voice, image, and messaging services for travelers, remote workers, maritime users, and individuals living outside traditional cellular network coverage areas.
Samarawickrama wrote, 'This opportunity goes far beyond emergency communication. It's about keeping people connected, no matter where they are.'
AST SpaceMobile is preparing to launch its latest batch of satellites and expand its satellite internet business into international markets.
According to the company's schedule, its BlueBird 11, 12, and 13 satellites will be launched on Wednesday morning local time aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.
The company's previous batch of 8-10 satellites was successfully deployed in June this year. These satellites can provide voice, data, and image services directly to standard, unmodified smartphones.
AST SpaceMobile recently submitted a filing to the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC), revealing plans to launch its Direct-to-Cell (D2C) business in Japan.

The filing shows that Japan is AST SpaceMobile's first international market, and the company will partner with local operator Rakuten Mobile to launch the service, using its approved spectrum, including the 715-718MHz band for uplink transmission and the 770-773MHz band for downlink communication.

AST SpaceMobile confirmed that it has obtained all necessary authorizations from Japanese regulatory authorities and will operate in accordance with the 'no interference' principle; if harmful interference occurs, the company can immediately shut down the relevant satellite beam.

items.title: 川普擬禁中國光收發模組進口！Lumentum、Coherent飆漲  中際旭創恐受衝擊
items.title_en: Trump Aims to Ban China-Made Optical Modules, Lumentum and Coherent Soar
paras: 四名知情人士指出，川普政府正草擬一項禁令，擬禁止美國進口中國製造的新款資料中心元件，以保護支撐人工智慧（AI）熱潮的關鍵基礎設施。
根據《路透》報導，負責監管美國電信產業的美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）正研擬這項措施，禁止進口中國製造的新款光收發模組。這類元件可讓資料在資料中心內透過光纖電纜以接近光速傳輸。官員希望於今年公布該措施，並在發布後正式生效。
這項此前未曾曝光的措施，主要目的在於防範中國廠商藉由相關設備竊取資料、植入惡意軟體，或干擾容納訓練與運行 AI 模型晶片的美國資料中心運作。
消息人士強調，FCC 仍可能修改或擱置此案。不過，此舉被視為川普政府近期一連串防堵中國技術滲透美國尖端產業行動的最新案例，目的是趁相關技術尚未深植供應鏈之前先下手為強。
華府顧問公司 Beacon Global Strategies 的 AI 政策專家 Divyansh Kaushik 分析指出：「光收發模組確實存在風險。隨著資料中心建設持續擴大，必須從一開始就確保資料中心供應鏈的安全。」
市場認為，美國政府這項措施將有利於美國本土光收發模組製造商，相關消息曝光後，相關個股股價應聲走高。
週二（4 日）收盤，Lumentum(LITE-US) 、Coherent(COHR-US) 、祥茂光電科技 (AAOI-US) 與邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) 股價分別大漲 8.92%、12.35%、19.44% 與 12.81%。

中國大使館：若有必要將採取反制措施

白宮與 FCC 均未回應。中國駐美大使館則表示，北京敦促美方「傾聽兩國工商界客觀理性的聲音」，並「停止抹黑中國企業、停止以制裁相威脅」。
大使館並強調：「中國將針對任何對自身利益造成實質損害的行動，採取一切必要措施予以回應。」
若美國禁止進口中國製新款資料中心設備，預料將衝擊全球最大光收發模組供應商之一的中際旭創 (300308-CN) 。
該公司今年 6 月已被美國國防部列入涉嫌與中國軍方有關聯的企業名單，而此類名單往往被視為美方後續祭出更嚴厲制裁的前兆。中際旭創未回應置評請求。
分析指出，這項禁令也可能推高美國雲端服務業者的成本，包括亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 雲端服務（AWS）等企業，因其可能被迫改向美國廠商 Coherent 與 Lumentum 等供應商採購產品。
川普政府內部對中國立場強硬的官員，希望避免重演華為事件。當年，儘管華為受到美方嚴厲制裁，但其電信設備早已深度部署於美國基礎設施，導致後續拆除工程耗時、成本高昂，且始終無法全面完成。
FCC 過去向來被視為獨立監管機關，但美國最高法院今年 6 月支持美國總統川普撤換一名民主黨籍聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）委員，使總統對聯邦政府、包括部分獨立監管機關的人事掌控權進一步擴大。
根據 Counterpoint Research 的資料，中際旭創目前約占全球資料中心光收發模組市場 27% 市占率，居全球領先地位。
美國創新基金會（Foundation for American Innovation）的報告指出，雖然 Coherent 與 Lumentum 擁有具競爭力的技術，但目前生產規模仍不足以完全取代中國供應商。
報告也指出，中際旭創約 90% 的營收來自中國以外市場。
AWS、Coherent 與 Lumentum 均未回應置評請求。
《路透》先前報導，FCC 已陸續對中國製無人機、路由器、機器人及逆變器祭出類似限制。
三名消息人士表示，依照相同模式，FCC 將禁止所有中國製新款光收發模組進口，同時對多數非中國供應商豁免相關限制。
川普第一任期時，曾大力批評中國企業涉嫌竊取智慧財產權，並指控華為配合中國政府從事間諜活動；華為則一再否認相關指控。
不過，相較第一任期，川普第二任期對中國採取較為克制的態度，部分原因是北京去年祭出稀土出口管制措施，增加美方施壓成本。
《路透》今年 2 月曾報導，美國商務部原本研擬一系列針對中國的進口限制措施，包括限制中國資料中心設備，但在去年 10 月美中貿易戰暫時降溫後，相關措施遭到擱置。
如今 FCC 已接手推動相關限制措施，並分別於去年 12 月及今年 3 月透過國會授權建立的「受管制清單」宣布禁止中國製無人機與路由器。
該名單旨在禁止未來被認定危害美國國家安全的外國企業設備進入美國市場，而針對中國製逆變器與機器人的限制措施也已於上週陸續推出。
paras_en: Sources close to the matter say the Trump administration is drafting an order to ban the importation of China-made new-generation data center components to protect critical infrastructure supporting the AI boom.

According to a Reuters report, the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is working on this measure, which would prohibit the importation of China-made new-generation optical transceivers. These components allow data to be transmitted at near-light speed through fiber optic cables within data centers.
The move, previously unreported, aims to prevent Chinese companies from stealing data, inserting malware, or disrupting the operation of US data centers that contain AI model chips.

The FCC may still modify or put the plan on hold, but this move is seen as the latest example of the Trump administration's efforts to block Chinese technology from infiltrating the US's cutting-edge industries.

Divyansh Kaushik, an AI policy expert at Beacon Global Strategies, a Washington-based consulting firm, said: 'Optical transceivers do pose a risk. As data center construction continues to expand, it's essential to ensure the security of the data center supply chain from the start.'
The market believes that this move will benefit US-based optical transceiver manufacturers, with related stocks surging after the news broke.

On Tuesday (4th), Lumentum (LITE-US), Coherent (COHR-US), Acacia Communications (AAOI-US), and Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) saw their stock prices jump 8.92%, 12.35%, 19.44%, and 12.81%, respectively.
The Chinese embassy in the US responded by saying that if necessary, they will take countermeasures.

The White House and FCC have not commented. The Chinese embassy emphasized that Beijing urges the US to 'listen to the objective voices of the business community' and 'stop smearing Chinese companies and stop threatening them with sanctions.'
The embassy also stated that China will take 'all necessary measures' to respond to any actions that cause 'actual harm' to its interests.
If the US bans the importation of China-made new-generation data center equipment, it is expected to impact the global largest optical transceiver supplier, ZTE (300308-CN).
ZTE was listed as a company suspected of having ties to the Chinese military by the US Department of Defense in June this year. The company has not responded to a request for comment.

Analysts point out that this ban may also increase the costs of US cloud service providers, including Amazon Web Services (AMZN-US), as they may be forced to switch to US-based suppliers like Coherent and Lumentum.

Trump administration officials who are tough on China hope to avoid a repeat of the Huawei incident. Despite Huawei facing severe US sanctions, its telecommunications equipment had already been deeply embedded in US infrastructure, leading to costly and time-consuming removal efforts.

The FCC has traditionally been seen as an independent regulatory agency, but the US Supreme Court supported President Trump's decision to replace a Democratic FTC commissioner in June, giving the president greater control over personnel at federal agencies, including some independent regulatory bodies.
According to Counterpoint Research, ZTE currently holds a 27% market share in the global data center optical transceiver market, leading the global market.

A report by the Foundation for American Innovation found that while Coherent and Lumentum have competitive technologies, their production capacity is still insufficient to completely replace Chinese suppliers.
The report also noted that ZTE generates approximately 90% of its revenue from non-China markets.
AWS, Coherent, and Lumentum have not responded to requests for comment.
Reuters previously reported that the FCC has imposed similar restrictions on Chinese-made drones, routers, robots, and inverters.
Three sources said that the FCC will ban all new-generation optical transceivers made in China, while exempting most non-Chinese suppliers from the restrictions.

During his first term, Trump strongly criticized Chinese companies for allegedly stealing intellectual property and accused Huawei of collaborating with the Chinese government on espionage activities; Huawei has repeatedly denied these allegations.

However, compared to his first term, Trump's second term has taken a more restrained approach to China, partly due to Beijing's imposition of rare earth export controls last year, which increased the cost of US pressure.

Reuters reported in February that the US Commerce Department had drafted a series of import restrictions on China, including data center equipment, but the measures were put on hold after the US-China trade war cooled down in October last year.
The FCC has since taken over the push for these restrictions and has listed China-made drones and routers on the 'controlled list' established by Congress in December last year and March this year.

The list aims to prohibit foreign companies deemed to pose a threat to US national security from entering the US market. Restrictions on Chinese-made inverters and robots were also implemented last week.

items.title: 美擬封殺中國光收發器！光通訊類股集體大漲 AAOI飆近20%
items.title_en: US Considers Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers, Boosting US Telecom Stocks
paras: 美國川普政府傳出正研擬禁止進口新款中國資料中心硬體，限制範圍可能涵蓋 AI 資料中心使用的光收發器。消息帶動美國光通訊類股週二 (4 日) 全面走強，投資人預期，一旦禁令正式實施，美國供應商可望承接原本由中國業者供應的訂單。
美股週二收盤，Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) 暴漲 19.44%，Coherent (COHR-US) 急漲約 12.27%，Lumentum (LITE-US) 勁揚 8.92%，康寧 (GLW-US) 也飛升約 9%。
《路透》引述 4 名知情人士報導，美國聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 正準備對中國製造的新款光收發器實施進口限制。光收發器是 AI 資料中心的關鍵零組件，主要負責透過光纖在伺服器與網路設備之間高速傳輸資料。
美國官員擔憂，陸製光收發器可能使 AI 基礎設施面臨資料遭竊、惡意軟體植入或服務中斷等風險，因此希望在今年內完成相關規範並開始執行。不過，這項政策仍處於草擬階段，FCC 最終仍可能修改甚至放棄相關計畫。
根據知情人士透露，FCC 考慮禁止所有新型號的中國光收發器進入美國市場，同時可能向部分非中國供應商提供豁免。這種做法與 FCC 先前針對中國無人機、路由器、機器人及太陽能逆變器採取的限制措施相似。
這項政策的主要影響對象之一，是中國光通訊設備大廠中際旭創 (300308-CN)。
根據 Counterpoint Research 資料，中際旭創掌握全球資料中心光收發器市場約 27% 的市占率，並於今年 6 月被美國國防部列入被指與中國軍方有關的企業名單。
美國創新基金會的資料則顯示，中際旭創約 90% 的營收來自海外市場。若美國正式禁止進口其新款產品，公司在全球最大 AI 資料中心市場之一的業務可能面臨壓力。
對亞馬遜 AWS 等超大規模雲端服務商而言，禁令可能迫使其重新調整供應鏈，改向 Coherent、Lumentum 及其他非中國廠商採購。由於替代產品的價格與供應能力仍有不確定性，資料中心建置成本也可能因此上升。
另一方面，美國光通訊廠商可望成為供應鏈轉移的主要受惠者。市場預期，如果中國競爭對手遭到排除，Coherent、Lumentum 與 AAOI 等業者不僅可能取得更多訂單，也有機會提高產能利用率與市場議價能力。
paras_en: The US Trump administration is reportedly considering a ban on importing new Chinese data center hardware, which could include optical transceivers used in AI data centers. This news drove a broad rally in US telecom stocks on Tuesday (4th), with investors expecting that once the ban is implemented, US suppliers could gain orders that were previously supplied by Chinese companies.
US stocks closed on Tuesday with Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) surging 19.44%, Coherent (COHR-US) jumping 12.27%, Lumentum (LITE-US) rising 8.92%, and Corning (GLW-US) also soaring 9%.

According to Reuters, citing four sources familiar with the matter, the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is preparing to impose import restrictions on new Chinese-made optical transceivers. Optical transceivers are a critical component of AI data centers, responsible for high-speed data transmission between servers and network equipment via fiber optic cables.

US officials are concerned that Chinese-made optical transceivers could pose risks to AI infrastructure, including data theft, malicious software injection, or service disruptions. They hope to complete the relevant regulations and start implementing them by the end of the year. However, this policy is still in the drafting stage, and the FCC may ultimately modify or abandon the plan.

According to sources, the FCC is considering banning all new models of Chinese optical transceivers from entering the US market, while possibly granting exemptions to some non-Chinese suppliers. This approach is similar to the FCC's previous restrictions on Chinese drones, routers, robots, and solar inverters.
The main target of this policy is China's leading optical communication equipment manufacturer, Zhongtian Xingda (300308-CN).

According to data from Counterpoint Research, Zhongtian Xingda holds around 27% of the global data center optical transceiver market share. In June this year, the US Department of Defense added the company to its list of entities suspected of having ties to the Chinese military.

US Innovation Foundation data shows that around 90% of Zhongtian Xingda's revenue comes from overseas markets. If the US formally bans the import of its new products, the company's business in the world's largest AI data center market may face pressure.

For Amazon's AWS and other large-scale cloud service providers, the ban could force them to re-adjust their supply chains and switch to Coherent, Lumentum, and other non-Chinese suppliers. Due to the uncertainty surrounding the prices and supply capabilities of replacement products, data center construction costs may also rise.

On the other hand, US telecom companies may benefit from the shift in supply chains. Market expectations are that if Chinese competitors are excluded, Coherent, Lumentum, and AAOI, among others, may gain more orders, increase their production utilization rates, and enhance their market bargaining power.

items.title: 三星FMS亮劍：公布全新3D記憶體路線圖 zHBM性能喊話達HBM5八倍 力爭在AI技術領域領跑
items.title_en: Samsung FMS Unveils zHBM: New 3D Memory Roadmap zHBM Performance Claims 8x HBM5, Chasing AI Leadership
paras: 三星電子在美國聖克拉拉舉行的 FMS 峰會上一口氣發布 zHBM、zNAND-O 兩款概念產品，以及業界首款堆疊超 400 層的 V10 BV-NAND，正面迎戰 SK 海力士與美光，試圖在 AI 時代重奪記憶體話語權。
zHBM 最受矚目，徹底顛覆現行 2.5D 封裝架構，不再將 HBM 與 AI 晶片並排於矽中介層上，而是直接垂直堆疊在加速器上方。
三星在 FMS 峰會上宣稱，藉由晶圓鍵合技術大幅縮短數據路徑，zHBM 性能可達下一代 HBM5 的 8 倍，記憶體密度超 10 倍，能效提升 3 倍，熱阻降低逾 50%，並支援客製化 IP 嵌入，預計 2029 年量產。
與此同時，三星透露今年 2 月已率先以 1c DRAM 製程與 4 奈米基底裸片量產 HBM4，5 月向客戶交付 HBM4E 樣品。
針對邊緣 AI 場景，三星推出 zNAND-O，定位與 SK 海力士、閃迪聯合發布的 HBF 形成差異。HBF 主攻伺服器端填補 HBM 與 SSD 間的分層空缺，zNAND-O 則鎖定端側大模型存儲，透過 TSV 與 UCIe 接口，實現高空間效率、低延遲與高 I/O 性能，預計 2028 年量產。
至於 V10 BV-NAND，距 2013 年首發 V-NAND 已過 13 年，三星首次導入晶圓鍵合架構，堆疊層數突破 400 層，存儲密度較 V9 提升 58%，讀寫與 I/O 性能全面優化，為 AI 系統提供高密度 NAND 支撐。
三星還展示全棧布局：LPDDR5X-PIM 為業界首款內建存算一體的 LPDDR 記憶體；企業級 PM1763、BM1773 則瞄準 AI 資料中心記憶體需求。
作為全球唯一同時掌握記憶體、晶圓代工與先進封裝的 IDM，三星意圖以一站式方案縮短客戶開發周期，在 AI 基礎設施賽道拉開與對手的身位差距，市場將關注這些「願景型」技術能否如期落地，並轉化為實質市場份額。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics unveiled its zHBM and zNAND-O concept products, as well as the industry's first stacked over 400-layer V10 BV-NAND, at the FMS conference in San Clara, USA. This move aims to challenge SK Hynix and Micron in the AI era and regain its dominance in the memory market.

zHBM is the most attention-grabbing product, completely revolutionizing the existing 2.5D packaging architecture. Unlike HBM and AI chips being placed side by side on the silicon interlayer, zHBM is vertically stacked on top of the accelerator.

Samsung claims that by using wafer bonding technology, the data path is significantly shortened, and zHBM performance can reach 8 times that of the next-generation HBM5, with a memory density over 10 times, a 3-fold increase in efficiency, and a heat resistance reduction of over 50%. It also supports customized IP insertion and is expected to be mass-produced in 2029.
At the same time, Samsung revealed that it had already produced HBM4 using a 1c DRAM process and a 4-nanometer bare wafer in February this year, and delivered HBM4E samples to customers in May.

For the edge AI scenario, Samsung launched zNAND-O, which is positioned to differentiate itself from SK Hynix and SanDisk's joint release of HBF. HBF targets server-side filling of the layered gap between HBM and SSD, while zNAND-O focuses on end-side large model storage, achieving high spatial efficiency, low latency, and high I/O performance through TSV and UCIe interfaces, with mass production expected in 2028.

As for V10 BV-NAND, it has been 13 years since the first V-NAND was released in 2013. Samsung has introduced wafer bonding architecture for the first time, stacking over 400 layers, with a 58% increase in storage density compared to V9, and comprehensive optimization of read-write and I/O performance, providing high-density NAND support for AI systems.

Samsung also showcased its full-stack layout: LPDDR5X-PIM is the industry's first LPDDR memory with built-in storage and computing; enterprise-level PM1763 and BM1773 are targeting AI data center memory needs.

As the world's only IDM that simultaneously controls memory, wafer foundry, and advanced packaging, Samsung aims to shorten customer development cycles with a one-stop solution and create a gap in the AI infrastructure market. The market will be watching to see if these 'visionary' technologies can be implemented as planned and converted into actual market share.

items.title: 蘇姿丰喊AI週期才剛開始 AMD揭Helios需求超預期
items.title_en: AMD's CEO Lisa Su Says AI Cycle Has Just Begun, Helios Demand Exceeds Expectations
paras: AMD(AMD-US) 在最新財報電話會議上釋出強勁成長訊號。董事長兼執行長蘇姿丰（Lisa Su）表示，隨著領先產品採用持續擴大，公司再次交出創紀錄季度業績，並強調「我們仍處於多年 AI 採用週期的早期階段」。
AMD 第二季營收達 115 億美元，年增 50%，稀釋每股收益較去年同期成長約 82%。公司表示，資料中心業務與核心客戶的大規模採購，是推動營運成長的主要動能。
蘇姿丰指出，AI 應用持續擴張，市場對加速器與 CPU 的需求都超出公司先前預期，整體資料中心市場機會的擴展速度也明顯高於六個月前的預估。
資料中心成核心引擎 營收年增 107%
資料中心業務成為 AMD 本季最大亮點。財報顯示，該業務第二季營收達 67 億美元，年增 107%，創下歷史新高，占公司總營收比重升至 58%，較一年前的 42% 明顯提升。
在伺服器 CPU 市場，AMD 旗下 EPYC 處理器連續第五個季度創下營收紀錄，雲端與企業客戶銷售均較去年同期成長超過 70%。新一代第六代 EPYC Venice 系列目前已投入生產，客戶需求也高於過往任何一代產品。
蘇姿丰表示，Venice 採用 Zen 6 核心與 2 奈米技術打造，每瓦效能優於領先 x86 CPU 兩倍以上，並達到領先 ARM CPU 的 3.3 倍水準。她指出，客戶對 Venice 的需求「比任何一代 EPYC 都更強勁」。
此外，資料中心 GPU 業務也受惠於雲端服務供應商與 AI 企業擴大部署，營收同樣較去年同期翻倍成長。
Helios 需求超預期 加速布局 AI 機架平台
在 AI 基礎設施布局方面，AMD 推出的機架級 AI 平台 Helios 成為市場關注焦點。該平台整合 Venice CPU 與 MI450 系列 GPU，定位為大型 AI 運算需求提供完整解決方案。
蘇姿丰表示，客戶對 Helios 的需求非常強勁，甚至超越公司最初預測。AMD 目前已與 OpenAI、Meta 展開多代吉瓦級部署合作，並宣布與 Anthropic 建立新的策略合作夥伴關係。
根據 AMD 說法，Anthropic 將在 Helios 平台部署最高達 2 吉瓦的 MI450 系列 GPU，其中首批 1 吉瓦部署預計於 2027 年上半年開始。此外，微軟也將在 Azure 平台大規模部署 Helios。
面向未來產品規劃，蘇姿丰表示，AMD 計畫每年推出新的機架級 AI 平台，並預期 MI500 將成為 Instinct 系列歷來最大的世代升級，使公司有望在四年內將推理效能提升超過 2000 倍。
上修市場規模 2027 年資料中心營收看翻倍
AMD 此次電話會議也大幅上調對 AI 與資料中心市場的長期展望。公司預估，資料中心 AI 加速器市場至 2030 年將以超過 45% 的年複合成長率擴大，市場規模約達 1.4 兆美元；伺服器 CPU 市場則預計以超過 50% 的年複合成長率成長，規模達約 2200 億美元。整體高效能與 AI 運算市場未來幾年預估將以約 40% 的年複合成長率成長，至 2030 年接近 2 兆美元。
在營運展望方面，AMD 預計 2026 年下半年伺服器營收年增超過 80%，並在更高基期下，預估 2027 年全年成長超過 70%；資料中心業務 2027 年營收則預計較 2026 年同期成長超過一倍。
蘇姿丰表示，AMD 目前正大幅超越去年 11 月提出的長期財務模型，公司預計營收將明顯高於原先超過 35% 的成長目標，並在策略時間框架內顯著超越每股收益 20 美元的年度目標。
非 AI 業務回溫 支撐整體營運表現
除了資料中心業務外，AMD 其他產品線也呈現不同程度復甦。由於半客製化銷售下降，遊戲業務第二季營收年減 31% 至 7.79 億美元，不過客戶端與嵌入式業務成長抵銷部分影響。
第二季客戶業務營收年增 23% 至 31 億美元，嵌入式業務營收年增 19% 至 9.77 億美元，創下三年多來最強勁成長表現。
財務長胡錦表示，嵌入式業務復甦將在 2027 年為公司毛利率帶來額外推動力，未來營運支出成長也將控制在低於營收成長速度的水平，以進一步提升營運槓桿並推動每股盈餘成長。
AMD 在電話會議中釋出的訊息顯示，公司正押注 AI 基礎設施需求持續擴張，並透過 CPU、GPU 及機架級 AI 平台布局，爭取多年 AI 運算週期帶來的成長機會。
AMD 2026 年第二季財報電話會議全文翻譯：
蘇姿豐，董事長兼執行長：
隨著我們領先產品的採用持續擴大，我們再次交出了出色的季度業績，營收和獲利能力均創下紀錄。營收年增 50%，達到 115 億美元，這得益於 EPYC、Instinct、Ryzen 和嵌入式處理器銷售額的大幅成長。資料中心營收年增超過一倍，目前佔總營收的 58%，高於一年前的 42%，這反映了我們的伺服器和資料中心 AI 業務規模的快速擴大。
我們的創紀錄業績標誌著 AMD 財務表現的另一個顯著提升，並展示了我們產品組合和執行力的強大。我們仍處於多年 AI 採用週期的早期階段，因為部署在廣泛的市場和工作負載中不斷增長，推動了對更多計算的需求，並為未來幾年的顯著營收成長和獲利能力創造了清晰的路徑。

轉向我們的細分市場。資料中心業務營收年增 107%，達到創紀錄的 67 億美元，這得益於 EPYC 處理器和 Instinct 加速器的強勁需求。在伺服器方面，我們連續第五個季度實現伺服器 CPU 營收創紀錄，雲端和企業銷售均年增超過 70%，超出了我們上季提供的展望。隨著客戶擴大了第五代 EPYC Turin 系列和第四代 EPYC Genoa 系列的部署，我們的 x86 伺服器營收市場份額較去年同期有所成長。

在雲端，超大規模客戶繼續在其內部基礎設施和公有雲產品中擴展 EPYC 的使用，包括 AWS、微軟、Google、甲骨文等。目前，全球超過 1600 種 EPYC 公有雲實例類型中，近三分之一由第五代 EPYC Turin 提供支持，供應商透過新的資料庫、儲存和 AI 工作負載擴大了其產品範圍。這種不斷擴大的覆蓋範圍正在轉化為雲端 EPYC 採用率的成長，上個季度，醫療保健、金融服務、媒體和科技公司增加了數千萬個實例。
企業方面，我們連續第四個季度實現創紀錄的銷售和創紀錄的 sell-through，這得益於我們 EPYC 產品組合的領先性能和 TCO 優勢，本地部署採用率加速增長。成長基礎廣泛，我們在領先的金融服務、製造業、電信、零售和科技公司贏得了大規模部署。目前，來自 HPE、戴爾、聯想、超微等公司的超過 230 個第五代 EPYC 平台已上市，這是我們迄今為止最廣泛的企業產品組合。

展望未來，Agentic AI 正在為伺服器 CPU 創造新的成長向量，涵蓋高頻 AI 主機節點、高密度 Agentic 伺服器以及通用雲端和企業工作負載。我們的第六代 EPYC Venice 系列專為這些不斷擴大的工作負載而設計，並實現了 EPYC 歷史上最大的代際性能提升之一。 Venice 基於我們全新的 Zen 6 核心和 2 奈米技術構建，每瓦性能是領先 x86 CPU 的兩倍以上，是領先 ARM CPU 的 3.3 倍。 Venice 系列包括 30 多款處理器，將領先的單核心和單插槽效能與廣泛的儲存和 IO 配置相結合，使客戶在優化效能、效率和 TCO 方面具有更大的靈活性。 Venice 現已投入生產，所有主要 OEM 廠商都按計畫推出平台，領先的雲端供應商計畫從今年稍後開始部署。客戶對 Venice 的需求比任何一代 EPYC 都更強勁，我們預計在未來幾季將繼續在雲端和企業領域擴大市場份額。
轉向我們的資料中心 AI 業務，得益於對 Instinct 加速器的強勁需求，營收年增超過一倍。隨著領先 AI 公司在越來越多的推理和訓練工作負載中擴大部署，以及雲端供應商擴大 MI350 的可用性，MI355x 的採用率持續擴大。
在我們的 Advancing AI 活動中，我們發布了 Helios，這是一個機架級 AI 平台，結合了 EPYC Venice CPU、MI450 系列 GPU、Pensando 網路和 ROCm 軟體。在廣泛的推理工作負載中，Helios 在相同機架功耗下提供高達 15% 的吞吐量提升，每美元代幣數比競爭對手高出高達 30%。客戶對 Helios 的需求非常強勁，並超越我們最初的預測。
除了與 OpenAI 和 Meta 的多代吉瓦級部署外，我們宣布與 Anthropic 建立新的策略合作夥伴關係。 Anthropic 將在 Helios 中部署高達 2 吉瓦的 MI450 系列 GPU，首批 1 吉瓦的部署將於 2027 年上半年開始。這項合作關係包括一項多年聯合工程合作，使用 Cloud 優化 Instinct GPU 的工作負載並加速 ROCm 軟體開發。
我們也擴大了與微軟的長期合作關係。微軟將在 Azure 大規模部署 Helios，用於微軟及其 AI 客戶以及 Azure AI 服務的前沿模型推理。這些合作共同擴大了領先 AI 公司和雲端供應商的群體，這些公司正在 AMD Helios 上建立下一代基礎設施。 Helios 現已投入生產，首批出貨按計畫於本季稍後開始，並在第四季及 2027 年持續提升，以滿足非常強勁的客戶需求。

展望 Helios 之後。我們計劃每年發布一個新的機架級 AI 平台，每一代都在效能、效率和 TCO 方面帶來顯著提升。 2027 年，我們的下一代平台將結合 MI500 系列 GPU、Verano CPU 和 Pensando 網絡，並具有擴展的 scale-up 域以及基於銅纜和光學的互連。客戶對 MI500 的參與度非常強，多家客戶在規劃其下一代 AI 基礎設施時與我們密切合作。我們預計 MI500 將實現 Instinct 史上最大的世代飛躍，使我們有望在短短四年內將推理性能提升超過 2，000 倍。
轉向我們的 AI 軟體棧，ROCm 已經達到了一個重要轉折點，其效能、能力和開發者體驗滿足了客戶大規模生產部署 AI 的需求。生態系的廣度也不斷擴大。超過 300 萬個模型現在可以在 AMD 上開箱即用。領先的開放模式在發佈時就支援 Instinct。在過去一年中，對 ROCm 的開源貢獻增加了十倍以上。

上個月，我們推出了 ROCm.ai，這是我們針對 AMD GPU 的新 AI 輔助開發平台。 ROCm.ai 允許開發者使用當今領先的編碼代理，包括 Claude、Codex 和 Cursor，為 Instinct 創建、移植和優化程式碼，使得將新模型和工作負載引入 AMD ROCm 變得更快、更容易。 ROCm.ai 在廣泛模型上的訓練表現是 ROCm 7 的兩倍以上，推理表現是其三倍以上。我們也與領先的 AI 實驗室密切合作，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta 等，共同優化 ROCm 以適應其模型，這些改進將使整個 AMD 生態系統受益。
整體來看，整體資料中心市場機會的擴展速度遠超我們六個月前的預期。隨著 AI 進入更廣泛的應用和工作負載的生產環境，對加速器和 CPU 的需求都遠遠超出了我們先前的預期。
我們現在預計，資料中心 AI 加速器市場到 2030 年將以超過 45% 的年複合成長率成長至約 1.4 兆美元。我們預計伺服器 CPU 市場到 2030 年將以超過 50% 的年複合成長率成長至約 2,200 億美元。
對 AMD 而言，這個更大的市場機遇，加上我們產品組合的實力和日益增長的客戶可見性，正為我們的資料中心業務創造更陡峭的成長軌跡。

在資料中心 AI 領域，Helios 和 MI450 系列 Instinct 部署的數量和規模不斷增加，這為業務在下半年的顯著成長奠定了基礎，並在 2027 年加速成長。在伺服器 CPU 方面，憑藉非常強勁的客戶需求和改善的供應，我們現在預計 2026 年下半年伺服器營收將年增超過 80%，並在更高的基數上，2027 年全年成長超過 70%。綜合來看，我們現在預計 2027 年資料中心細分市場營收將年增超過一倍。
轉向客戶端和遊戲業務。細分市場營收年增 6%，達 38 億美元。

在客戶端，營收年增 23%，達到 31 億美元，這得益於創紀錄的行動處理器營收和持續的市場份額成長。本季度，商業採用率持續擴大，Ryzen Pro 銷售額年增超過 50%，我們在大型醫療保健、科技、汽車和金融服務公司贏得了新的合作。為延續這一勢頭，戴爾、惠普、聯想、華碩等公司推出了廣泛的商業 PC 新產品組合，這些產品搭載了我們最新一代的 Ryzen AI Pro 400 系列處理器。對 Ryzen AI Halo 開發者係統的需求也很強勁，該系統在本季上市。
7 月，我們推出了下一代 Ryzen AI Halo 平台，該平台由我們新的 Gorgon Halo 處理器驅動，具有業界領先的 192GB 統一內存，可運行高達 3000 億參數的模型。為了進一步方便開發者在本地建立和測試大型 AI 模型，我們正在與 Hugging Face 合作，從今年稍後開始，為每台 Ryzen AI Halo 系統附帶一年的 Hugging Face Pro 訂閱。
展望下半年，我們預期 PC 市場將因更高的儲存和組件成本對需求造成壓力而有所疲軟。在此背景下，我們預期我們的客戶端業務表現將優於市場，這得益於我們不斷上升的產品組合實力和日益增長的商業採用率。
在遊戲業務方面，營收年減 31% 至 7.79 億美元，主要由於遊戲機週期現階段半客製化銷售額下降。遊戲圖形營收也較去年同期下滑，因為產業範圍內更高的組件成本導致顯示卡價格上漲，並對整體需求造成壓力。

轉向我們的嵌入式業務，營收年增 19% 至 9.77 億美元，這是我們三年多來最強勁的成長。需求基礎廣泛，在網路、航太與國防、測試測量與模擬、通訊客戶中表現強勁。本季度，我們的嵌入式 x86 業務大幅成長，因為超大規模客戶和網路客戶越來越多地採用我們的 CPU 來為資料中心的關鍵網路和控制平面功能提供動力。我們也繼續擴大我們的產品組合，推出了針對要求苛刻的即時邊緣 AI 工作負載的 Ryzen AI Embedded X100 處理器，以及實體 AI 的 Kria AI Robotics Platform。
paras_en: AMD (AMD-US) released a strong growth signal in its latest earnings call. CEO Lisa Su stated that with the continued expansion of leading product adoption, the company has once again delivered record quarterly performance, emphasizing that 'we are still in the early stages of a multi-year AI adoption cycle'.

AMD's second-quarter revenue reached $11.5 billion, up 50% year-over-year, with diluted earnings per share growing by approximately 82% compared to the same period last year. The company attributed the growth in operations to the large-scale purchasing of data center businesses and core customers.
